news.impact: Andrews led the tight end group in targets and receptions in the loss to the Bengals. Andrews has not seen the same target share with Tyler Huntley at quarterback, so it would be a welcome sight for fantasy managers if Lamar Jackson is able to play in Week 8.

news.body: Baltimore Ravens tight end Mark Andrews caught just one pass for four yards in the Week 6 road loss against the Cleveland Browns
news.head: Mark Andrews quiet in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Andrews saw a season-low three targets in a tight contest with rookie tight end Josh Cuevas catching the lone touchdown of the night. The veteran has been held under 30 yards for four consecutive weeks while providing a low-end fantasy output.

news.body: Mark Andrews secured 4-of-6 targets for 28 yards in Sunday's 30-23 OT win against the Falcons.
news.head: Mark Andrews grabs four passes in Week 5 win
news.impact: Andrews limited PPR contribution was diminished by a lost fumble Sunday night. The veteran TE finished behind wide receivers Zay Flowers and Rashod Bateman in both catches and yards. Andrews is still a significant factor in the Ravens' offense, as he's caught 22 passes through five games. However, he's scored just once and is averaging barely over 8.0 yards per reception.

news.body: Mark Andrews caught 5-of-6 targets for 27 yards and a touchdown in the Ravens win over the Titans.
news.head: Mark Andrews finds the end zone in Week 4 win
news.impact: Andrews caught a three-yard touchdown pass late in the second quarter to extend the Ravens' lead. This marked the veteran's first trip to the end zone this season. Andrews will look to build on this performance against the Falcons in Week 5.

news.body: Mason Taylor caught 5-of-6 targets for 62 yards and two touchdowns in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
news.head: Mason Taylor hits pay dirt twice in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Taylor has seen six targets in back-to-back games for the Jets and accounted for two of the team's three touchdowns Sunday. Taylor appears to be more trusted than Kenyon Sadiq by Geno Smith, leaving Taylor as the better option heading into Week 8.

news.body: Mason Taylor caught 4-of-6 targets for 33 yards in a 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Mason Taylor hauls in four passes in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Taylor led the tight end group in receptions, yards, and targets. Taylor and Kenyon Sadiq should be expected to continue to split time heading into Week 7.

news.body: Mason Taylor caught all three of his targets for 24 yards in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
news.head: Mason Taylor catches three passes in Week 5
news.impact: Taylor finished third on the Jets in receiving in the close win after missing the previous three games with a thumb injury. He might be in line for a larger role in Week 6 vs. the Patriots with Kenyon Sadiq suffering a concussion in Week 5's win.

news.body: Mason Taylor (thumb) will be active for Sunday's game against the Browns.
news.head: Mason Taylor (thumb) to return Sunday
news.impact: Taylor has missed each of the last two weeks due to a thumb injury, but the second-year TE will be back for Sunday's game. Jeremy Ruckert and Jelani Woods figure to see fewer snaps as a result.

news.body: Michael Mayer caught all three of his targets for 32 yards in the Raiders’ 35-21 loss to the Rams in Week 7.
news.head: Michael Mayer catches three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Mayer has seen inconsistent involvement in the Las Vegas passing attack of late, receiving three targets or less in three of his last five contests. The tight end remains difficult to trust in all formats as long as Brock Bowers remains healthy, with a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets up next.

news.body: Michael Mayer hauled in 7-of-9 targets for 95 yards in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Michael Mayer hauls in seven passes Sunday
news.impact: Mayer had a great performance on Sunday. He set a new career high in receiving yards against the Bills, racking up 95 on his seven catches, which left him with a great fantasy total. He may have some good games here or there moving forward, but he's unlikely to be a reliable week-to-week asset with TE Brock Bowers still easily ahead of him in the pecking order at this point.

news.body: Michael Mayer caught his lone target for two yards in a loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Michael Mayer disappears in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Mayer's one target set a new season low for the 25-year-old tight end. With Brock Bowers continuing to dominate the target share, Mayer is tough to trust in Week 6 against Buffalo.

news.body: Michael Mayer caught eight of his 10 targets for 82 yards in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
news.head: Michael Mayer goes for 82 yards in Week 4
news.impact: Mayer finished second on the team in receiving behind only Brock Bowers. His involvement alongside Bowers has been encouraging as Mayer caught a touchdown back in Week 3. Mayer is worth a look as a tight end streamer in deeper fantasy leagues going forward. He will face the Patriots in Week 5.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught his lone target for six yards and a touchdown in a 35-13 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Mike Gesicki hits pay dirt in Week 7
news.impact: Gesicki found the end zone in the third quarter to open the scoring for the Bengals on their way to a comeback win. The veteran tight end has five touchdowns in six games so far this season. Gesicki and the Bengals will take on the Titans in Week 8.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught 1-of-2 targets for four yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Mike Gesicki finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Gesicki was pretty uninvolved on Sunday in general, but he was able to leave his mark on the game by connecting with QB Joe Burrow on a short four-yard touchdown. He still didn't end with a good fantasy total, however, and should not be started in most leagues moving forward.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught 3-of-5 targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 22-17 loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Mike Gesicki catches touchdown in loss Sunday
news.impact: The veteran had an pretty good game on Sunday. He finished with 40 yards and a touchdown against the Jaguars, although that wasn't enough to help the Bengals pick up a win at home. Gesicki may be a great fantasy option in Week 5 with Ja'Marr Chase (concussion) and Tee Higgins (adductor) both at serious risk of missing time.

news.body: Mike Gesicki caught 3-of-3 targets for 37 yards and a touchdown in a 30-27 loss to the Steelers.
news.head: Mike Gesicki finds the end zone in Week 3 loss
news.impact: Gesicki had a much needed bounce back performance after failing to record a target in Week 2. He tallied his second touchdown of the season on a 25-yard touchdown reception early in the fourth quarter. Gesicki will look to build on this performance in Week 4 against Jacksonville.

news.body: Oronde Gadsden II failed to catch his only target in Sunday's 23-17 loss to the Broncos.
news.head: Oronde Gadsden II targeted just once in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Even with the Chargers' receiving corps a bit beaten up, Gadsden was a non-factor for the offense. This came a week after catching a season-high five passes for 36 yards. Gadsden, as with the Chargers' offense on the whole, just cannot be depended on at present.

news.body: Oronde Gadsden II caught 5-of-8 targets for 36 yards in the Chargers 30-23 loss against the Seahawks.
news.head: Oronde Gadsden II catches five passes Sunday
news.impact: Gadsden was a safety blanket for Justin Herbert with his longest reception going for nine yards. He'll be a TE2 play next week against the Broncos.

news.body: Oronde Gadsden II failed to catch any of his three targets in the Chargers' 24-16 loss to the Buffalo Bills in Week 3.
news.head: Oronde Gadsden II sees three targets in Week 3
news.impact: Gadsden II has been minimally involved in the Los Angeles passing attack early on, seeing three targets or less in each of the first three games. The tight end remains difficult to trust ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Seattle Seahawks.

news.body: Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said TE Oronde Gadsden II is "ready to step up."
news.head: Oronde Gadsden II 'ready to step up' per HC Jim Harbaugh
news.impact: Gadsden will be stepping into a bigger role with both David Njoku and Charlie Kolar sidelined. He'll be a viable streamer for fantasy managers.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth caught two of four targets for 20 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth held to two catches in win
news.impact: After two games with a combined three touchdowns, Freiermuth has just four receptions for 31 yards in the last two games. He's a risky streaming tight end at best.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth caught 2-of-3 targets for 11 yards in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth quiet Sunday
news.impact: Freiermuth was playing through a calf injury that landed him on the injury report right before Sunday. He'll be more reliable if he can practice fully next week.

news.body: Steelers TE Pat Freiermuth (calf) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with Tampa Bay.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth (calf) officially active for Week 6
news.impact: Freiermuth was a late addition to the injury report this week, but has been cleared to play after pregame warmups. The veteran has appeared more involved in the offense as of late, scoring three touchdowns in his last two games.

news.body: Pat Freiermuth has been added to the injury report as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Buccaneers.
news.head: Pat Freiermuth (calf) now questionable Sunday
news.impact: Freiermuth was a late addition to the injury report with a calf injury. His status will need to be monitored Sunday morning.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught 1-of-2 targets for just 18 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Sam LaPorta disappoints in win Sunday
news.impact: LaPorta had a disappointing performance on Sunday. He was only able to catch one pass over the course of the entire game, and he was only able to rack up 18 scoreless yards on it, which left him with a poor fantasy total. He should bounce back in the near future, though he will remain prone to bad showings in the future.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught five passes for 88 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Sam LaPorta stellar in win Sunday
news.impact: LaPorta looked great again on Sunday, finishing as Detroit's leading receiver with 88 yards and a touchdown on five catches against the Cardinals. He has been playing very well and remains a must-start fantasy option for the time being.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught 8-of-13 targets for 84 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Sam LaPorta hits paydirt in Sunday's loss
news.impact: LaPorta put up new season highs in receptions and yards Sunday night, tying for the team lead with eight grabs. LaPorta also scored for the second time this season. He's not a sure thing every week, but LaPorta is a definite top-10 TE with top-five upside the rest of the way.

news.body: Sam LaPorta caught 3-of-4 targets for 44 yards in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
news.head: Sam LaPorta tallies three receptions in Week 3
news.impact: LaPorta saw the bulk of the targets go to Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs in the win over the Jets. Fantasy managers will hope that LaPorta can become more involved against the Panthers in Week 4.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson caught 4-of-5 targets for 35 yards and a touchdown in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson catches touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Hockenson hauled in a short touchdown from Kyler Murray. He'll be a low-end TE1 next week against the Lions.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson (concussion) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson (concussion) practices in full Wednesday
news.impact: Hockenson was previously going through the NFL's concussion protocols, but he was able to practice in full on Wednesday and should be fully cleared to play in time for Sunday's game. He isn't likely to be much more than a streaming option on a week-to-week basis for the foreseeable future, however.

news.body: T.J. Hockenson (concussion) will take part in Minnesota's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson (concussion) will practice Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran tight end is going to be available to practice on Wednesday. He was placed in the NFL's concussion protocols before their bye week, but his time off allowed him to recover, and it looks like he will be available to play in Week 7. It remains to be seen if he will be limited at practice early in the week, however.

news.body: The Vikings placed TE T.J. Hockenson in concussion protocol.
news.head: T.J. Hockenson placed in concussion protocol
news.impact: Hockenson left Sunday's game early against the Saints. His status heading into Week 6 is up in the air.

news.body: Carolina Panthers tight end Tommy Tremble caught two touchdowns on four targets in a 25-14 Week 6 win.
news.head: Tommy Tremble scores pair of TDs in Week 6
news.impact: Tremble had four receptions for 46 yards and now has 4+ targets in every game this season except one. He also has 40+ yards in two games and caught the first two touchdowns of his season.

news.body: Tommy Tremble (rib) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Tommy Tremble (rib) listed as limited Thursday
news.impact: The veteran was able to practice on Thursday, though he remained limited again due to the rib issue that he's managing. He could be sidelined in Week 6, and if he is, fantasy managers should expect Darren Waller (toe) to play more snaps in a matchup against the Eagles.

news.body: Tommy Tremble practiced again on Thursday.
news.head: Tommy Tremble (ribs) practices Thursday
news.impact: Tremble remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Tommy Tremble (ribs) was a limited participant on Wednesday.
news.head: Tommy Tremble (ribs) limited Wednesday
news.impact: Tremble was left limited at Wednesday's practice due to an injury to his ribs that he's dealing with. If it leaves him sidelined in Week 6, look for Darren Waller (toe) to see more work as a result of his absence.

news.body: Travis Kelce caught four of his eight targets for 44 yards in a 20-3 loss to the Seahawks in Week 7.
news.head: Travis Kelce catches four passes in Week 7
news.impact: Kelce led the Chiefs in targets and receiving yards while tying for the lead in catches in the disappointing loss. The veteran tight end has notched at least 44 receiving yards in five of his six games this year. He will be a low-end TE1 in Week 8 vs. the Broncos.

news.body: Travis Kelce was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Travis Kelce (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Kelce is being managed in practice to start the week. He should be good to go in his usual role for Sunday.

news.body: Travis Kelce caught four passes for 53 yards in the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers in Week 6.
news.head: Travis Kelce Records 53 Receiving Yards in Week 6
news.impact: Kelce wasn't needed for a big performance with Kansas City controlling the game behind Walker and its defense. Still, 53 yards kept his floor intact despite failing to score. Kelce remains a weekly low-end TE1.

news.body: Travis Kelce caught two of his four targets for 15 yards in a 30-27 win over the Raiders in Week 4.
news.head: Travis Kelce quiet in Week 4 win
news.impact: Kelce was quiet in the win as Tyquan Thornton and Xavier Worthy did most of the damage in the passing attack. Kelce has been a solid fantasy tight end this season, catching 16 passes for 246 yards and two touchdowns in four games. He will be on bye in Week 5 before taking on the Chargers in Week 6.

news.body: Trey McBride caught 10 of 13 targets for 111 yards and one touchdown in the Cardinals' 30-16 loss to the Broncos in Week 7.
news.head: Trey McBride Goes Over 100 Yards, Scores in Week 7
news.impact: McBride accounted for 10 of Jacoby Brissett's 27 completions and 111 of his 272 passing yards. He also caught Arizona's only touchdown, scoring from seven yards out in the third quarter. With 13 targets and no other Cardinal seeing more than eight, McBride remains one of fantasy football's safest elite TE1 options.

news.body: Trey McBride hauled in 7-of-9 targets for 53 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Trey McBride leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: McBride continues to produce well in PPR scoring formats, hauling in seven passes in Sunday's upset win over the Rams. He wasn't able to turn those seven catches into much, but fantasy managers should still be satisfied with the performance that he put up.

news.body: Trey McBride hauled in 9-of-10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Trey McBride hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: The star tight end played well on Sunday. He was able to record 66 yards and a touchdown on his nine catches, which left him with a great fantasy total on the afternoon. He should continue to be great moving forward, even with Arizona not expected to win many games over the course of the season.

news.body: Trey McBride hauled in 7-of-12 targets for 31 yards in Sunday's 36-24 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Trey McBride hauls in seven passes Sunday
news.impact: McBride saw plenty of opportunities on Sunday, but he wasn't able to do much with them. His seven passes turned into just 31 yards, so if someone started him in a non-PPR league format, his fantasy finish was quite disappointing for them. He should bounce back and return to form sometime within the next week or two, however.

news.body: Tucker Kraft hauled in 4-of-6 targets for 49 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Tucker Kraft finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Kraft had a solid game on Sunday. He was able to haul in four passes for 49 yards on the afternoon, one of which he was able to get into the end zone on as well. He should continue to be viewed as a weekly starter at the tight end position moving forward.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught five of his eight targets for 37 yards in a 23-13 win over the Cowboys in Week 6.
news.head: Tucker Kraft catches five passes in Week 6
news.impact: Kraft finished tied for second on the team in targets but was able to manage just 37 yards in the win. The veteran tight end now has 25 catches for 249 yards and one touchdown in six games for the Packers this year. He will be a strong TE1 in Week 7 vs. the Lions.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught all five of his targets for 64 yards while also rushing once for two yards in the Packers' 31-7 win over the Chicago Bears in Week 5.
news.head: Tucker Kraft sees six touches in Week 5
news.impact: Kraft has seen increased involvement in the Green Bay passing attack of late, logging five or more targets in each of his last three contests. The tight end will look to offer more impactful output moving forward, with a Week 6 contest against the Dallas Cowboys up next.

news.body: Tucker Kraft caught six of his seven targets for 42 yards and a touchdown while adding a three-yard run in a 17-14 win over the Buccaneers in Week 4.
news.head: Tucker Kraft finds the end zone in Week 4
news.impact: Kraft scored his first touchdown of the season on a two-yard pass from Jordan Love. The veteran tight end set a season-high in receptions in the game as he continues to ramp up after last season's ACL tear. Overall, Kraft has 15 catches for 148 yards and one touchdown. He will be a TE1 in fantasy in Week 5 against the Bears.

news.body: Tyler Higbee caught two of his three targets for 14 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
news.head: Tyler Higbee quiet in Week 7 win
news.impact: Higbee has cooled off of late, finishing with less than 25 receiving yards in each of the last two contests. The tight end remains one of the more stable pass-catching options as part of a banged-up Rams offense, with a Week 8 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Tyler Higbee caught four passes for 22 yards in Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Tyler Higbee catches four passes Sunday
news.impact: Higbee caught four passes over the course of the afternoon on Sunday, but he wasn't able to do much with them, racking up just 22 yards in a loss to the Cardinals. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward.

news.body: Tyler Higbee is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Cardinals.
news.head: Tyler Higbee off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Higbee will be good to go despite not practicing on Friday.

news.body: Tyler Higbee caught five of his six targets for 83 yards in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Tyler Higbee goes for 83 yards in Week 5
news.impact: Higbee finished second on the Rams in receiving on Monday night, behind only Puka Nacua. The veteran tight end has earned a larger role in the team's offense thanks to some injuries in the LA tight-end room, having caught 18 passes for 212 yards and a touchdown over his past three contests. Higbee is looking like a solid fantasy option heading into Week 6 vs. Arizona.

news.body: Tyler Warren (groin) has been ruled out for Week 7 by the Indianapolis Colts according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) ruled out for Week 7

news.body: Tyler Warren did not practice on Thursday.
news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) not practicing Thursday
news.impact: Warren missed another practice. He'll likely need to practice in some capacity on Friday to have a chance to return this week.

news.body: Tyler Warren (groin) did not take part in Indianapolis' practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: Warren was sidelined in Week 6 due to a groin issue, and he wasn't able to practice on Wednesday for the same reason. He's at risk of being sidelined again this week, but we won't know his official status until sometime later on in the week.

news.body: Colts TE Tyler Warren (groin) is officially inactive for Week 6.
news.head: Tyler Warren (groin) officially inactive for Week 6
news.impact: Warren was a late addition to the injury report this week and was only able to practice in a limited capacity Friday. Mo Alie-Cox will see the bulk of the playing time at tight end against the Titans.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell did not record a reception on three targets in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell held without a reception in Week 7
news.impact: Mitchell was held without a catch in his return from a finger injury. He was overshadowed by an excellent performance from Omar Cooper. Fantasy managers can leave Mitchell out of their lineups in Week 8.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell (finger) will play Sunday against the Dolphins.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell (finger) will return in Week 7
news.impact: Mitchell has not played since Week 2, but he has been practicing this week and will return to the field Sunday. Mitchell was off to a strong start for the Jets this season, hauling in 9-of-15 targets for 123 yards over the first two games. With Garrett Wilson and rookie Omar Cooper Jr. both out there as well, it will be interesting to see how Mitchell works back into the mix.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell (finger) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell (finger) listed as limited Thursday
news.impact: Mitchell was again a limited participant at practice on Thursday, as he's still working his way back from a finger injury that has left him sidelined for multiple weeks. It looks like he's trending towards playing in Week 7, but we likely won't know his official status until after practice on Friday.

news.body: Adonai Mitchell (finger) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Adonai Mitchell (finger) officially limited Wednesday
news.impact: Mitchell has been out for several games while nursing a finger injury, but it seems that he is finally returning to form, as he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday. His return this week would be less than ideal for rookie Omar Cooper Jr., who showed signs of a breakout last week.

news.body: A.J. Brown hauled in 3-of-6 targets for 48 yards in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: A.J. Brown grabs three passes in Thursday's loss
news.impact: Since returning from a four-week absence, Brown has now secured just 6-of-16 targets for 75 yards over the last two games. He looked a little more up to speed Thursday night, but he's still well below the top-tier fantasy option he once was. Better games should be on the way from Brown, but right now, he's difficult to trust in fantasy lineups.

news.body: A.J. Brown (ankle) is good to go for Thursday night's game against the Chicago Bears.
news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle) good to go for Thursday
news.impact: Brown was limited for New England's first two practices this week, but he returned to being a full participant on Wednesday and carries no injury designation ahead of Thursday night's game. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him in this primetime matchup, even though he had a rough showing in his first game back last week.

news.body: A.J. Brown caught 3-of-10 targets for 27 yards in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets.
news.head: A.J. Brown hauls in three passes in Week 6 win
news.impact: Brown struggled with drops Sunday, logging three drops in his return to action after a Week 1 ankle injury. Brown and the Patriots play on Thursday, so it is a quick turnaround for the veteran to knock off any additional rust heading into Week 7.

news.body: The Patriots activated A.J. Brown from injured reserve.
news.head: A.J. Brown (ankle) activated from IR
news.impact: Brown will make his return for the first time since Week 1. He'll be a WR2 with some risk in his first game back for fantasy managers.

news.body: Colts coach Shane Steichen said Alec Pierce will not practice this week.
news.head: Alec Pierce (heel) will not practice this week
news.impact: Pierce remains without a clear timetable to return. He is week-to-week.

news.body: Colts WR Alec Pierce is still a few weeks away from a return to game action.
news.head: Alec Pierce (heel) weeks away from returning
news.impact: Pierce was able to get out of his cast earlier this week. He remains week-to-week.

news.body: Alec Pierce is reportedly no longer wearing a cast but is not close to a return.
news.head: Alec Pierce (heel) out of cast, not close to returning
news.impact: Pierce went on injured reserve with a heel injury after Week 2. He has his first chance to return in the Colts’ Week 7 game against the Vikings.

news.body: Alec Pierce (heel) will be placed on IR and has no projected timetable for recovery.
news.head: Alec Pierce (heel) to be placed on IR
news.impact: This was an expected move by the Colts. Pierce is attempting to rehab his heel injury instead of undergoing surgery. The big-play wide receiver will miss at least four weeks, and probably longer. Veteran receiver Darius Slayton was signed by the Colts earier this week.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown hauled in 9-of-11 targets for 153 yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: The veteran wideout played very well on Sunday. He led the team with 153 receiving yards over the course of the afternoon, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone to put the cherry on top. Fantasy managers should continue to regard him as a top-tier option moving forward.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown caught 6-of-11 targets for 69 yards in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown racks up 69 yards Sunday
news.impact: The star wideout had an okay game on Sunday. He racked up 69 yards in an easy win over the Cardinals, but he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, which left him with a mediocre fantasy total to his standards. He has had a great start to the season overall and should continue to be a high-end fantasy option moving forward.

news.body: Amon Ra St. Brown came up with 8-of-11 targets for 75 yards in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown makes eight grabs in Week 4 loss
news.impact: St. Brown failed to make it four straight games with a touchdown to start the season, but he still produced a solid showing. St. Brown has largely delivered for fantasy managers over the first quarter of the season, averaging nearly eight receptions for more than 75 yards with five scores to this point. He remains a certain WR1.

news.body: Amon-Ra St. Brown caught 4-of-8 targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
news.head: Amon-Ra St. Brown finds the end zone in Week 3 win
news.impact: St. Brown was not able to capitalize on his eight targets, but was able to help salvage the day with a touchdown in the second quarter. St. Brown now has five touchdowns through the first three games of the season and will look to build on a strong start to the season against the Panthers in Week 4.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught three of his four targets for 50 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
news.head: Antonio Williams finishes with 50 receiving yards in Week 6
news.impact: Williams finished third on the team in receiving in the loss on Monday night. The rookie wideout has shown flashes this season but his role hasn't been large enough to be trusted as a weekly starter in fantasy. He could see more work after his bye in Week 7, after Terry McLaurin had to be carted off the field during Monday night's game against the 49ers. Williams is worth a waiver claim in most leagues this week.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught all three of his targets for 31 yards in the Commanders' 27-27 tie with the New York Giants in Week 5.
news.head: Antonio Williams quiet in Week 5 tie
news.impact: Williams has struggled to make an impact of late, finishing with less than 35 receiving yards in each of the last four games. The wideout remains another risky pass-catching option in the Washington offense for head coach Dan Quinn, with a Week 6 contest against the San Francisco 49ers up next.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught 3-of-8 targets for 21 yards in the Commanders loss to the Colts.
news.head: Antonio Williams hauls in three passes in Week 4
news.impact: Williams was second on the team in targets, just one behind Stefon Diggs. Williams could continue to see more playing time next week if Terry McLaurin does not return from his hamstring injury.

news.body: Antonio Williams caught two of his four targets for 15 yards in the Commanders’ 33-31 Week 3 win over the Seattle Seahawks.
news.head: Antonio Williams quiet in Week 3 win
news.impact: Williams has fallen back to earth after an impressive showing in Week 1, finishing with less than 25 receiving yards in each of the last two games. The wideout remains a risky-pass catching option in an inconsistent offense early on, with a Week 4 matchup against the Indianapolis Colts up next.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. was held without a catch on two targets in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. vanishes in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Thomas has now been held without a catch in two consecutive games, and did not see an offensive snap after halftime. Fantasy managers should feel comfortable benching Thomas, or at least moving on when the Jaguars return after their Week 7 bye.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. did not record a reception on three targets in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. puts up a goose egg in Week 5
news.impact: It is noteworthy that Thomas came up just a sideline toe touch short of scoring for the second straight week in this game. Still, Thomas has seen only six combined targets over the last three contests, and he seems to be in just a complementary role for the Jaguars at the moment.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. caught two passes for 17 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Thomas was able to haul in Jacksonville's lone passing touchdown against the Bengals. He wasn't able to do much outside of that, however, totaling just 17 yards over the course of the afternoon. He has had a slow start to the season and should not be considered a viable fantasy option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Brian Thomas Jr. caught one pass for eight yards in Sunday's 35-6 blowout win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Brian Thomas Jr. quiet in blowout win Sunday
news.impact: Thomas was a complete non-factor on Sunday. He caught just one pass over the course of the afternoon, and he was only able to turn that into eight yards on a day that Jacksonville's offense had no trouble scoring and moving the ball. He still has some potential given his talent, but he hasn't been productive for a while and shouldn't be started for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Caleb Douglas caught 2-of-3 targets for 70 yards and two touchdowns in a 28-25 win over the Jets.
news.head: Caleb Douglas finds the end zone twice in Week 7
news.impact: Douglas found the end zone on a seven yard reception and a 63-yard reception to help pace the Dolphins to their first win of the season. This marked the first game Douglas has played in since suffering an injury in Week 2, and he provided an immediate jolt in the Dolphins' passing attack. Douglas will look to build on this performance against the Patriots in Week 8.

news.body: Dolphins WR Caleb Douglas (ankle) is officially active for Week 7 matchup with the Jets.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (ankle) officially active for Week 7
news.impact: Douglas has been out of action since Week 2. Prior to his injury, he had seven receptions for 113 yards in his first two NFL games. Fantasy managers should expect him to be involved in the Dolphins' passing attack.

news.body: Caleb Douglas (ankle) is expected to play against the Jets on Sunday.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (ankle) expected to play in Week 7
news.impact: After a strong NFL debut back in Week 1, Douglas was knocked out early in his second career game and has not played for the Dolphins since. That should change this week, as the rookie has been active at practice leading into a divisional matchup against the Jets. Fellow rookie Kevin Coleman Jr. likely stands to lose snaps if Douglas does return.

news.body: Caleb Douglas (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Caleb Douglas (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The rookie seems to be doing much better after Miami's bye week. He was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday after missing several games with an ankle issue. His return would be good news for Miami's entire offense moving forward, though he isn't likely to have much individual fantasy value for the time being.

news.body: Carnell Tate caught five of his seven targets for 69 yards and lost a fumble in a 27-24 loss to the Browns in Week 7.
news.head: Carnell Tate goes for 69 yards in Week 7
news.impact: After slow performances in Weeks 1 and 2, Tate continues to ascend in the Tennessee offense as he's hit at least 58 receiving yards and five catches in four of his past five contests. The rookie wideout will be a solid fantasy play in Week 8 vs. the Bengals.

news.body: Carnell Tate caught six of seven targets for 70 yards and a touchdown in the Titans' 26-20 win over the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Carnell Tate snags touchdown in win over Colts
news.impact: Titans QB Cam Ward threw for 11 completions and 107 yards in this contest, meaning Tate accounted for over 50% of his completions and 65% of his passing yards. Only four Titans caught a pass on Sunday, and only Tate and Wan'Dale Robinson went over 10 yards. Tate has been a volume magnet so far this year, and it looks like he will continue to be. He's closing in on WR2 territory, but Ward's inconsistency will keep his floor low.

news.body: Carnell Tate caught 1-of-5 targets for six yards in the Titans 26-3 loss on Sunday against the Texans.
news.head: Carnell Tate quiet Sunday
news.impact: After a couple big performances, Tate was no where to be found this week. He'll be a WR3 play next week against the Colts.

news.body: Titans WR Carnell Tate (back) is officially active for a Week 5 matchup with Houston.
news.head: Carnell Tate (back) officially active for Week 5
news.impact: Tate was considered questionable after being limited in practice Thursday and Friday. He will suit up and provide the Titans with their best option at wide receiver against Houston.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb hauled in 5-of-12 targets for 74 yards and two touchdowns in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb hauls in two touchdowns Monday
news.impact: Lamb wasn't able to connect with Prescott on over half of his targets, but he was able to make the most out of the ones that he did catch, finishing with 74 yards and two touchdowns in a comfortable win over the Eagles. He will continue to be a top-tier fantasy option moving forward, assuming he remains healthy.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb caught nine of his 18 targets for 70 yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb goes for 70 yards in Week 6
news.impact: Lamb drew an impressive number of targets but was inefficient with the workload, catching just half of them while averaging just 7.8 yards per catch. The veteran wideout now has 48 catches for 577 yards and four touchdowns through six games. He will be a high-end WR1 in fantasy in Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb is practicing in full for Week 6 against the Packers.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb (quad) practicing in full for Week 6
news.impact: Lamb left the game late last week with a quad injury. He remains a locked and loaded WR1.

news.body: CeeDee Lamb injured his quad during Thursday night's loss to the Buccaneers.
news.head: CeeDee Lamb sustains quad injury Thursday night
news.impact: Lamb finished Thursday's game with only two receptions on five targets for a total of nine yards. He bounced in and out of the contest after sustaining a quad injury, but he was clearly in pain and simply could not do much for the Cowboys' offense. On a positive note, the injury is considered to be mild, and the extra rest following a Thursday game should give Lamb time to recuperate.

news.body: Chris Bell caught 3-of-4 targets for 25 yards in a 28-25 win over the Jets.
news.head: Chris Bell hauls in three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Bell caught his first pass since Week 3, but was not heavily featured in the Dolphins' passing attack. Fantasy managers should look elsewhere for wide receiver production for now.

news.body: Chris Bell failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 31-24 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Chris Bell held catchless in loss Sunday
news.impact: The rookie had a terrible showing on Sunday, being held without a catch for a second-straight week. He was able to pick up 26 yards on his lone rush attempt, but that did nothing to fix his lack of production as a receiver. He should not be started in nearly any league format at this point in the season.

news.body: Chris Bell (knee) was a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Chris Bell (knee) limited at practice Thursday
news.impact: Bell was able to participate in a limited fashion at practice on Thursday, which was to be expected, given that the injury is not considered more than a minor issue at this point. It shouldn't affect his availability for Week 5, but fantasy managers shouldn't consider him more than a streaming option at this point in the season.

news.body: Chris Bell was seen practicing again on Thursday.
news.head: Chris Bell (knee) seen practicing Thursday
news.impact: Bell was limited to begin the week on Wednesday. He'll likely be limited again on Thursday as he trends towards being good to go this weekend.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught four of five targets for 27 yards in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. catches four passes in win
news.impact: While the final stat line is a bit disappointing considering Emeka Egbuka did not play, it's important to remember Baker Mayfield threw only 11 passes for 64 yards. Godwin had a 45% target share and a 42% receiving yards share with those numbers. So again, nothing much to write home about in the final box score, but his actual market share was great. He could be interesting next week against the Falcons

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught 4-of-8 targets for 37 yards in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. catches four passes Sunday
news.impact: Godwin was second on the team in targets, but it didn't result in much production. He remains off the fantasy radar with Jalon Daniels behind center.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught all three of his targets for 37 yards in the Bucs' 24-16 win over the Cowboys on Thursday. He also ran once for three yards.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. snags three passes in win
news.impact: Godwin started off hot with two catches on the first drive, but fizzled out quickly with only a single catch the rest of the way. Emeka Egbuka was the favorite target of rookie QB Jaylon Daniels, with Godwin sitting tied for third on the team in targets behind Cade Otton and Kenny Gainwell. Godwin is a risky start at this point, and his value is more closely tied to real life than to fantasy.

news.body: Chris Godwin Jr. caught six of his seven targets for 31 yards in a 17-14 loss to the Packers in Week 4.
news.head: Chris Godwin Jr. hauls in six catches in Week 4
news.impact: Godwin led the Bucs in targets and catches but managed just 5.2 yards per catch in rookie quarterback Jalon Daniels' debut. The veteran wideout has 16 catches for 142 scoreless yards through four games this year. He will be a low-end flex option in Week 5 against Dallas.

news.body: Chris Olave caught six of ten targets for 56 yards in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Chris Olave snags 6 passes in loss
news.impact: Olave was second on the team in receiving yards by one, but led in targets by three over RB Alvin Kamara. It wasn't the game we would have hoped for Olave, but it certainly wasn't something that ruined your week. He's been quiet over the last three weeks, aside from a touchdown last Sunday. He will look to have better results against Cleveland after the Saints' bye.

news.body: Chris Olave caught 4-of-7 targets for 43 yards and a touchdown in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Chris Olave hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: It wasn't a huge day for Olave, but he made up for it with a touchdown. He will remain a WR1 heading into next week against the Steelers.

news.body: Saints WR Chris Olave (illness) is officially active for a Week 6 matchup with the Giants.
news.head: Chris Olave (illness) officially active for Week 6
news.impact: Olave was able to practice Friday but was listed as questionable to play as a precaution. The Saints will have their top pass catcher active against the Giants.

news.body: Chris Olave is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Giants.
news.head: Chris Olave (illness) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Olave returned to practice on Friday. He should be on the favorable side of questionable heading into Sunday.

news.body: 49ers WR Christian Kirk (calf) is officially active for a Week 7 matchup with the Falcons.
news.head: Christian Kirk (calf) officially active for Week 7
news.impact: Kirk is set to make his debut for the 49ers and could be heavily involved with Deebo Samuel and Mike Evans both out due to injury. Fantasy managers should expect Kirk to see plenty of playing time against Atlanta.

news.body: Christian Kirk (calf) is questionable for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Christian Kirk (calf) questionable for Sunday
news.impact: Kirk has yet to make his debut for the 49ers this season, but it may come on Sunday, as he is officially considered questionable to play against the Falcons. If he's cleared to play, he will likely be in line for a good amount of work right away with Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) and Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) both currently sidelined for San Francisco.

news.body: Christian Kirk (calf) logged a full practice session on Wednesday.
news.head: Christian Kirk (calf) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Kirk was able to log a full practice session on Wednesday, which bodes very well for his availability for Week 7. If active, he will see more work than usual in the event that Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) and Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) are ruled out against the Falcons.

news.body: Christian Kirk will not play in Monday's game against the Commanders.
news.head: Christian Kirk (calf) will not play Monday
news.impact: Kirk was listed as questionable entering Monday. He will hope to return in Week 7.

news.body: Christian Watson caught 5-of-8 targets for 57 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Christian Watson leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Watson played a decent game on Sunday. He was able to lead the team with 57 receiving yards on the day, but he didn't get into the end zone at all and only caught five passes, which left him with a mediocre fantasy finish. He will continue to be a must-start option on a week-to-week basis for as long as he continues to be productive.

news.body: Christian Watson (ankle) has officially been cleared to play in Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Christian Watson (ankle) officially cleared to play Sunday
news.impact: The star wideout is officially off of the team's injury report and will be available to play on Sunday. Fantasy managers should feel good starting him in what projects to be a great matchup against the Lions on Sunday.

news.body: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said there's no concern for the status of Christian Watson.
news.head: Christian Watson (ankle) will be good to go Sunday
news.impact: Watson is on the injury report with an ankle injury. He'll be good to go for Sunday's game against the Lions.

news.body: Christian Watson (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Christian Watson (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Watson is a new addition to the team's injury report, being listed with an ankle injury of some kind that left him limited at practice on Wednesday. It doesn't seem to be a serious issue, but fantasy managers should keep close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the week nonetheless.

news.body: Cody White caught one of his three targets for four yards in the Raiders' 35-21 loss to the Los Angeles Rams in Week 7.
news.head: Cody White quiet in Week 7
news.impact: White has offered mixed results of late, finishing with less than 10 receiving yards in four of seven contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets.

news.body: Cody White caught 2-of-4 targets for 44 yards in the Raiders loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Cody White hauls in two passes in Week 5
news.impact: White tied his season high in targets with four and set a new season high in receiving yardage. Fantasy managers can leave White off their radar for now.

news.body: Cody White (ankle) was a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Cody White (ankle) limited participant Wednesday
news.impact: White was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, though he's still being bothered by an ankle issue. It looks likely that he will play through it in Week 5, but we won't know for sure until later in the week.

news.body: The Raiders signed WR Cody White to their active roster.
news.head: Cody White signs with Raiders' active roster
news.impact: White has scored three touchdowns in the past two weeks. He gets the opportunity with Jack Bech (forearm) placed on IR.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught both of his targets for 20 yards in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Cooper Kupp goes for 20 yards in Week 7
news.impact: Kupp was quiet just one week after drawing 10 targets vs. the Broncos. The veteran wideout continues to operate as Seattle's No. 2 receiver, although the majority of the work goes to Jaxon Smith-Njigba. Kupp will be a low-end flex option in Week 8 vs. the Bears.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught five of ten targets for 50 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 loss to the Broncos on Thursday.
news.head: Cooper Kupp goes for 50 yards in loss
news.impact: Kupp had arguably his best game of the season, with season-highs in targets, receptions, and yards, lacking only a touchdown. He is a bit of a risky start most weeks, as his volume has been low for the most part. A near 20% target share this week is a nice sign of life, but we will need to see more consistency to really feel comfortable starting him.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught 2-of-3 targets for 15 yards in the Seahawks 32-29 loss against the 49ers on Sunday.
news.head: Cooper Kupp part of crazy ending Sunday
news.impact: On 4th-and-10 with the game on the line, Kupp caught an 8-yard pass, made one defender miss and dove for the first down. After review, he wound up being short by one yard. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Cooper Kupp caught 1-of-2 targets for 13 yards in the Seahawks 30-23 win over the Chargers.
news.head: Cooper Kupp quiet Sunday
news.impact: Kupp remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught three of five targets for 45 yards in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: Courtland Sutton Held to 45 Yards in Week 7
news.impact: Sutton averaged 15 yards per reception but wasn't involved in either of Bo Nix's explosive touchdowns. He also finished behind Jaylen Waddle in targets for the second straight week. Sutton isn't a viable fantasy starter. Denver's expanding group of playmakers make his weekly production volatile.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught two of three targets for 19 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 win over the Seahawks on Thursday.
news.head: Courtland Sutton catches two passes in win
news.impact: Sutton was quiet in this game, though there wasn't much to go around when the team combined for 107 passing yards. It's been a rough start to the year for QB Bo Nix, and until he improves, the pass catchers will suffer.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught 2-of-3 targets for 18 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 23-17 win over the Chargers.
news.head: Courtland Sutton catches first touchdown of the season
news.impact: Sutton found the end zone for the first time this season during Sunday's win, but the veteran receiver still hasn't really gotten going. Sutton has finished with three or fewer receptions in all five weeks so far. He's also topped out at 46 yards. Sutton cannot be relied upon for much fantasy production in the Broncos' lackluster passing attack right now.

news.body: Courtland Sutton caught one of his six targets for four yards in Sunday's 24-14 loss to the San Francisco 49ers.
news.head: Courtland Sutton held to four yards Sunday
news.impact: Sutton had a rough day despite tying for the team lead among wide receivers with six targets. He and Bo Nix couldn't connect on several opportunities, leaving Sutton with just one catch. The volume remains encouraging, and fantasy managers shouldn't overreact to one bad game, but Sutton will need to bounce back first after his quiet Week 4 before entering starting lineups.

news.body: Cyrus Allen caught one of his two targets for an 18-yard gain in a 20-3 loss to the Seahawks in Week 7.
news.head: Cyrus Allen brings in 18-yard pass in Week 7
news.impact: Despite an increased role due to injuries, Allen has just three catches for 45 yards over his past two games. The rookie wideout does not need to be rostered in most fantasy leagues heading into Week 8 against the Broncos.

news.body: Cyrus Allen was a full participant in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Cyrus Allen (knee) logs full practice Wednesday
news.impact: Allen is likely to be good to go on Sunday. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Cyrus Allen didn't see a target or touch in Sunday night's 33-30 overtime win over the Indianapolis Colts.
news.head: Cyrus Allen entirely uninvolved Sunday
news.impact: The rookie saw very little involvement for a second-straight game on Sunday night, which makes him unlikely to be productive for the foreseeable future. Fantasy managers should feel comfortable dropping him in favor of someone who has been getting more work for the first couple games of the season.

news.body: Cyrus Allen did not haul in his lone target in Monday night's 31-10 win over the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Cyrus Allen held catchless in win Monday
news.impact: The rookie was silent in his NFL debut on Monday, being held without a catch in the team's big win over the Broncos. They didn't need to pass much in this matchup, so it's possible that he will improve and play better in closer games moving forward. Still, this was a discouraging debut from a utilization standpoint, and fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Darius Cooper brought down 2-of-3 targets for 71 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Darius Cooper finds the end zone again in Week 5
news.impact: With DeVonta Smith (hamstring) missing each of the last two games, Cooper has now hit paydirt three times over the last two weeks and four times this season. The second-year pro is certainly proving himself as a big-play option for QB Jalen Hurts, but Cooper is still limited in the volume of targets thrown his way.

news.body: Darius Cooper hauled in 3-of-7 targets for 33 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 24-20 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Darius Cooper hauls in two touchdowns in loss Sunday
news.impact: Cooper was one of the lone bright spots on Philadelphia's offense on Sunday. He caught both of the team's passing touchdowns against the Rams, although he was only able to rack up 33 yards in the process. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be a good fantasy option moving forward, however, especially with DeVonta Smith (hamstring) set to make his return to the lineup at some point.

news.body: Darius Cooper caught three of his five targets for 33 yards in a 24-17 loss to the Commanders in Week 18.
news.head: Darius Cooper hauls in three balls in Week 18
news.impact: Cooper turned in season-highs across the board with the Eagles resting several key starters on offense, including A.J. Brown. He will go back to a depth role next week in a Wild Card matchup against the 49ers.

news.body: The Eagles activated WR Darius Cooper from injured reserve.
news.head: Darius Cooper (shoulder) activated from IR
news.impact: Cooper had been designated to return earlier this week. He will be active on Sunday.

news.body: Rams head coach Sean McVay told reporters that WR Davante Adams ruptured his hamstring and now will be sidelined 6-10 weeks.
news.head: Davante Adams to miss 6-10 weeks with ruptured hamstring
news.impact: It is another brutal injury for the Rams and for fantasy managers. They'll likely continue to involve the tight ends even more in the passing game.

news.body: Davante Adams caught 3-of-4 targets for 39 yards before leaving Sunday's 18-16 loss to the Arizona Cardinals early with a leg injury of some kind.
news.head: Davante Adams suffers leg injury in loss Sunday
news.impact: Adams wasn't having a good game late on Sunday, and things got worse when he suffered a lower-body injury of some kind late in the game. Los Angeles wasn't able to pick up the win, and fantasy managers should keep very close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the week.

news.body: Davante Adams caught five of his seven targets for 51 yards and two touchdowns in a 37-34 overtime loss to the Bills in Week 5.
news.head: Davante Adams brings in two TD passes in Week 5
news.impact: Adams found the end zone twice in the high-scoring loss on Monday night. He kicked off the scoring for LA with a four-yard grab in the second quarter and later came back to add a five-yard catch for a score. Adams now has 27 catches for 441 yards and four touchdowns through five games for the Rams. He will be a solid WR2 in Week 6 vs. the Cardinals.

news.body: Davante Adams is off the injury report for Monday's game against the Bills.
news.head: Davante Adams off injury report Monday
news.impact: Adams received a rest day in practice during the week. He'll remain a WR2 play for fantasy managers.

news.body: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan told reporters he expects Deebo Samuel Sr. to be good to go following the 49ers Week 8 bye week.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) expected to return after bye week
news.impact: Samuel hasn’t practiced since injuring his hamstring in the 49ers Week 5 win over the Seahawks. He'll hope to return after the bye week.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) won't play in Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) won't play Sunday
news.impact: As expected, the veteran is going to miss another game on Sunday as he continues to nurse a hamstring injury. QB Brock Purdy doesn't project to be as strong of a fantasy option this week with him and Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) ruled out for this matchup against the Falcons.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) was absent from San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) absent from practice Wednesday
news.impact: To no surprise, Samuel wasn't able to practice on Wednesday. He missed last week's game because of his hamstring issue, and he is expected to miss more time beyond that for the same reason. Christian Kirk (calf) may be one of the primary beneficiaries of his absence.

news.body: Deebo Samuel Sr. has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Commanders.
news.head: Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) ruled out Monday
news.impact: Samuel will miss at least one game as expected. He remains week-to-week.

news.body: DeMario Douglas brought in 3-of-4 targets for 23 yards in Thursday's 30-24 loss to the Bears.
news.head: DeMario Douglas catches three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Douglas delivered back-to-back big games in Week and Week 6, but he fell back down to Earth against the Bears. Drake Maye heavily relied on his running backs and tight ends Thursday night, not leaving much for Douglas behind fellow wideout A.J. Brown. Douglas may have already had his best games of the season and will likely be tough to rely on for fantasy purposes going forward this season.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught 7-of-8 targets for 86 yards and a touchdown in a 26-19 win over the Jets.
news.head: DeMario Douglas finds the end zone in Week 6 win
news.impact: Douglas led the team in receptions and receiving yards and found the end zone for the second straight game. If Rome Doubs (shoulder) is forced to miss any time, Douglas will likely see an increase in playing time. The Patriots take on the Bears Thursday.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught 4-of-5 targets for 65 yards and two touchdowns in the Patriots win over Las Vegas.
news.head: DeMario Douglas hits pay dirt twice in Week 5 win
news.impact: Douglas found the end zone on receptions of eight and 35-yards, accounting for his first scores of the season. Douglas has an opportunity to become a key component of the offense with AJ Brown and Mack Hollins on injured reserve. Douglas and the Patriots will take on the Jets in Week 6.

news.body: DeMario Douglas caught 2-of-3 targets for 15 yards in the Patriots win over the Bills.
news.head: DeMario Douglas held to two receptions in Week 4
news.impact: Douglas continues to see limited targets in the Patriots' offense. Fantasy managers should feel comfortable leaving him on the waiver wire heading into Week 5.

news.body: Denzel Boston caught three of his eight targets for 27 yards in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: Denzel Boston catches three balls in Week 7
news.impact: Boston drew a healthy eight targets but he wasn't able to do much with the opportunities while fellow rookie KC Concepcion posted a career day with eight catches for 129 yards. Boston now has 20 catches for 372 yards and three touchdowns in seven games this year. He will be a flex option in Week 8 against the Steelers.

news.body: Denzel Boston (foot) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Denzel Boston (foot) limited Wednesday
news.impact: The rookie is still dealing with a nagging foot issue and was limited for another practice on Wednesday as a result. He was able to play through it last week, however, so he is expected to do the same again in Week 7 unless he suffers a setback at practice this week.

news.body: Cleveland Browns rookie wide receiver Denzel Boston logged a season low in receptions (one) with 15 yards in a Week 6 win over Baltimore.
news.head: Denzel Boston logs one catch in Week 6
news.impact: Boston has been a high point for Cleveland's offense, recording 40+ yards in the first five games to open his career. The rookie was still involved, earning five targets, though the opportunities did not translate into production. He should have another opportunity for a spike week against Tennessee in Week 7.

news.body: Denzel Boston (foot) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Baltimore Ravens.
news.head: Denzel Boston (foot) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: The rookie will be good to go on Sunday, despite dealing with a foot injury at practice throughout the week. He has been good through the first five weeks of the season and can safely be started in most league formats at this point.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught all five of his targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in the Saints' 16-10 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Devaughn Vele snags touchdown in loss
news.impact: Vele caught the Saints' only touchdown in this game, very much helping out his final fantasy line. He was one of four Saints to finish between 57 and 54 receiving yards, joining Barion Brown, Alvin Kamara, and Chris Olave. Vele has been a great waiver pickup for the first half of the season, but with the Saints going on bye and Jordyn Tyson expected back soon after it, it could be tough for Vele to have much relevance moving forward.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught 3-of-6 targets for 42 yards in the Saints 34-27 win over the Giants.
news.head: Devaughn Vele totals 42 yards Sunday
news.impact: Vele was the second-leading receiver on the day for New Orleans. He is a borderline flex play in games where the passing volume is low for the Saints.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught four of his six targets for 26 yards in the Saints' 23-13 Week 5 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
news.head: Devaughn Vele bottled up in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Vele has made an inconsistent impact in the New Orleans passing attack, finishing with under 40 receiving yards in two of his last three contests. The wideout will look to get back on track for head coach Kellen Moore in Week 6 against the New York Giants.

news.body: Devaughn Vele caught 6-of-9 targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 45-24 loss to the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Devaughn Vele finds end zone Monday
news.impact: Vele's strong start to the season continued on Monday night. He caught six passes for 54 yards over the course of the game, one of which he was able to take to the house for a touchdown. He will continue to have solid week-to-week upside until Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) is back in the lineup for the Saints.

news.body: Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver DeVonta Smith has been ruled out for Monday Night Football in Week 7 against the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) ruled out vs. Dallas
news.impact: This is how the week trended, with Smith not practicing at all heading into Week 7. Smith had returned after a multi-game hiatus for Week 6, catching a touchdown from quarterback Tanner McKee; now, McKee will be without a key offensive weapon.

news.body: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) is not taking part in Philadelphia's practice on Friday.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) not practicing Friday
news.impact: The veteran wideout is not taking part in the team's practice for a second-straight day on Friday, which raises some questions about his availability for Week 7. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on updates about his health throughout the rest of the week to see if he will play on Monday night or not.

news.body: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) missed Philadelphia's practice on Thursday.
news.head: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Smith is still dealing with a lingering hamstring issue, but he played through it last week, so it seems his absence at practice was more of injury management on the part of the team. He should play on Monday night, but he may be a risky starter with QB Tanner McKee set to be the starter for the Eagles moving forward.

news.body: Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver DeVonta Smith caught seven passes for 75 yards and scored a fourth-quarter touchdown in a 25-14 loss to the Carolina Panthers.
news.head: DeVonta Smith finds end zone in Week 6
news.impact: Smith paced Philly in yards and receptions in Week 6, returning from a two-week absence for a hamstring injury. He has been heavily targeted when on the field, recording 35 targets in his last three games. He also has 50+ yards in every game and has scored twice, giving him a strong floor and weekly upside.

news.body: DJ Moore (shoulder) is inactive for Week 6 for the Buffalo Bills against the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: DJ Moore (shoulder) inactive for Week 6
news.impact: Moore will be sidelined for the second consecutive week as the wideout continues to battle through a shoulder injury. Keon Coleman and Khalil Shakir will see increased targets in Moore’s absence against the Raiders Sunday.

news.body: DJ Moore was in a non-contact jersey in practice on Friday.
news.head: DJ Moore (shoulder) in non-contact jersey Friday in practice
news.impact: Moore returned to practice, but in limited fashion. His status will need to be monitored on the official injury report.

news.body: DJ Moore (shoulder) missed another practice session on Thursday.
news.head: DJ Moore (shoulder) misses another practice Thursday
news.impact: Moore was sidelined for a second-straight practice on Thursday. The team continues to hold him out due to a nagging shoulder issue, and it remains to be seen if it will affect his availability for Week 6. If it does, fantasy managers should expect more work for Keon Coleman against the Raiders as a result.

news.body: DJ Moore (shoulder) did not take part in Buffalo's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: DJ Moore (shoulder) doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: Moore was sidelined at practice on Wednesday. The team held him out due to a shoulder injury that has been bothering him for a while, but it seems likely that he will return to practice on Thursday and play through it in Week 6, assuming he doesn't suffer any setbacks throughout the week.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught two of six targets for 56 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: DK Metcalf hauls in big 51 yarder in win
news.impact: Metcalf has been very up and down this season, with a big 115 yard performance against Cleveland followed up by 12 yards the following week, then an 11-for-93 stat line last Sunday, and finally two for 56 this Sunday. He's a boom-bust receiver for now; if you can afford to let him have his ups and downs, then he's a fine start. But more than likely, he's a risky flex at best.

news.body: DK Metcalf caught 11-of-15 targets for 93 yards in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: DK Metcalf hauls in 11 passes Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf took over late as he totaled 12 targets in the fourth quarter and overtime period alone. He'll remain in the WR2/WR3 range with both Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson on IR.

news.body: DK Metcalf is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Buccaneers.
news.head: DK Metcalf (illness) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf had been listed as questionable with an illness. He'll be good to go with the Steelers wide receiver room depleted.

news.body: DK Metcalf (illness) is now questionable to play in Sunday's game against the Tampa Bay Buccaneers.
news.head: DK Metcalf (illness) now questionable to play Sunday
news.impact: Metcalf is a new addition to Pittsburgh's injury report, being listed with an illness that left him sidelined at practice on Friday. He's now considered questionable to play heading into the weekend, and although it seems more likely than not that he will suit up, fantasy managers should still keep close tabs on all updates about his health over the next couple of days.

news.body: Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver Dontayvion Wicks was ruled out for Monday Night Football against Dallas due to an ankle injury.
news.head: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) out for Week 7
news.impact: Wicks did not practice this week, so this does not come as a surprise. However, multiple important players will miss Week 7, including Wicks and wide receiver DeVonta Smith. Quarterback Tanner McKee will rely on a patchwork offense in a divisional matchup.

news.body: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) was absent from Philadelphia's practice on Friday.
news.head: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) absent from practice Friday
news.impact: Wicks was not spotted at another practice session on Friday, which will mark the second-straight day that he has been a non-participant. His ankle injury may very well leave him sidelined this week, which would lead to more opportunities for rookie Makai Lemon against the Cowboys.

news.body: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) was sidelined at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Dontayvion Wicks (ankle) sidelined at practice Thursday
news.impact: The young wideout wasn't able to practice on Thursday, as he's managing an ankle issue of some kind right now. It could threaten his availability for Week 7, but only if he's not able to practice on Friday either.

news.body: Philadelphia Eagles wide receiver Dontayvion Wicks caught two passes for 24 yards in Week 6 against the Carolina Panthers.
news.head: Dontayvion Wicks catches two passes in Week 6
news.impact: Wicks had a quiet day after his eight-target outing against Jacksonville in London in Week 5. His four targets were more in line with his season average — he has earned 4-5 in four of six games — but he had a season low in yardage. With Jalen Hurts sidelined, Wicks' role could change going forward.

news.body: Drake London caught 7-of-10 targets for 66 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Drake London hauls in a touchdown during Week 7 win
news.impact: London finally hit paydirt this season. He's having a great season, but the end zone had simply eluded the fifth-year star over the first six weeks of the campaign. That changed in the fourth quarter of Sunday's upset of the 49ers. London is now averaging 5.4 receptions and 88 yards per game. He is a certain WR1 for fantasy purposes.

news.body: Drake London hauled in four of his team-leading 10 targets for 62 yards in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Drake London sees 10 targets in Week 6 loss to Bears
news.impact: London continues to make the most of his role as the primary option in an inconsistent Atlanta passing attack, registering 10 or more targets in three of the last four contests. The wideout will look to make a more explosive impact in a Week 7 matchup against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Drake London caught 7-of-11 targets for 118 yards in Sunday's 30-23 OT loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Drake London eclipses 100 yards in Sunday's loss
news.impact: London went over 100 yards for the second time in three weeks Sunday night, and he only missed the mark by four yards in Week 4. Surprisingly, London has still yet to find the end zone on any of his 27 grabs this season. London has looked nothing less than a WR1 with Michael Penix at QB for the Falcons. Unfortunately, Penix (ribs) is now dealing with another injury.

news.body: Drake London hauled in 5-of-6 targets for 96 yards in Monday night's 45-24 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Drake London leads team in receiving Monday
news.impact: Most of Atlanta's receiving options didn't see much work on Monday with how dominant the team's running game was, but London was the exception to that. He fell just four yards shy of a 100-yard outing against the Saints and finished with another good performance for fantasy managers. He has looked great ever since QB Michael Penix Jr. took the starting job for the Falcons, so he should continue to be a great fantasy asset for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Efton Chism III caught 5-of-6 targets for 57 yards in the Patriots win over the Raiders. He added two rushing yards on one carry.
news.head: Efton Chism III hauls in five passes in Week 5 win
news.impact: Chism led the team in targets with six, setting an new season high in targets, yards, and receptions. With Mack Hollins and AJ Brown on injured reserve, Chism appears to be carving out a role in the offense.

news.body: Efton Chism III caught 2-of-4 targets for 42 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots win over the Bills.
news.head: Efton Chism III finds the end zone in Week 4 win
news.impact: Chism made an impressive 23-yard touchdown reception late in the fourth quarter to give the Patriots the lead and the win Sunday. His two receptions and 42 yards establish new season highs, but Chism could be asked to do more in Week 5 if Mack Hollins (calf) is unable to suit up against Las Vegas.

news.body: Efton Chism III caught both of his targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots 42-10 win over the Jets.
news.head: Efton Chism III finds the end zone in Week 17
news.impact: Chism caught a 10-yard pass for a touchdown in the third quarter, accounting for his first career score. The Patriots were depleted at wide receiver, giving Chism an opportunity to play on offense. The rookie will look to build on this performance in Week 18 against Miami.

news.body: Efton Chism III is inactive for Week 1 for the New England Patriots against the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Efton Chism III inactive for Week 1
news.impact: Chism III is a healthy inactive for head coach Mike Vrabel against the Raiders and is little more than a depth option in the New England offense when active to begin the season.

news.body: Elic Ayomanor caught three of his seven targets for 44 yards in a 27-24 loss to the Browns in Week 7.
news.head: Elic Ayomanor goes for 44 yards in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Ayomanor tied with Carnell Tate for the team lead with seven targets. The three catches go down as Ayomanor's best effort of the season as he's been held to just one catch in five of seven games. He will not be a strong fantasy play heading into Week 8 vs. the Bengals.

news.body: Elic Ayomanor caught his lone target for 22 yards in the Titans loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Elic Ayomanor held to one reception in Week 4
news.impact: Ayomanor continues to see a limited target share in his second season in the NFL. The 23-year-old would likely need an injury to Carnell Tate or Wan'Dale Robinson to become an option for fantasy managers.

news.body: Elic Ayomanor caught 1-of-3 targets for just 11 yards in Sunday's 12-7 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Elic Ayomanor held to 11 yards Sunday
news.impact: Ayomanor had a nice showing in Week 2, but he followed that up with a very poor performance in Week 3, being held to just 11 yards in a loss to the Giants. Fantasy managers should feel no desire to roster him at this point in the season.

news.body: Elic Ayomanor caught two of his three targets for 69 yards in a 24-20 loss to the Eagles in Week 2.
news.head: Elic Ayomanor leads Titans in receiving in Week 2
news.impact: Ayomanor led the Titans in receiving in a game where they only passed for 183 yards. The second-year WR has been the Titans' best pass-catcher through two games, catching three passes for 80 yards and a touchdown. He will be a low-confidence flex option in Week 3 against the Giants.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) has been ruled out for Week 7 by the Tampa Bay Buccaneers according to Greg Auman.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) ruled out for Week 7

news.body: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) missed another practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Egbuka was again unable to practice on Thursday. He was seen working off to the side with a trainer, but unless he's able to return to team drills on Friday, it looks like he's going to be sidelined in Week 7. If that's the case, that would lead to more work for rookie Ted Hurst III against the Panthers.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka was working on the side during practice on Thursday with a trainer.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) working on side with trainer Thursday
news.impact: It will likely be the second straight missed practice for Egbuka. He'll need to practice in some capacity on Friday.

news.body: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) did not take part in Tampa Bay's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Emeka Egbuka (concussion/foot) doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: Egbuka wasn't able to practice on Wednesday. He's managing a foot issue of some kind and also seems to be in the NFL's concussion protocols, which could pose a threat to his availability for Week 7. Fantasy managers should keep close tabs on all updates about his health throughout the week to see whether or not he will be able to suit up against the Panthers on Sunday.

news.body: Garrett Wilson caught 2-of-3 targets for 26 yards in a 28-25 loss to the Dolphins.
news.head: Garrett Wilson quiet in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Wilson turned in his worst performance of the season Sunday, with the star receiver not seeing a target until the second half. Wilson will look to bounce back against Las Vegas in Week 8.

news.body: Garrett Wilson caught 4-of-6 targets for 44 yards in the Jets' 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Garrett Wilson hauls in four passes in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Wilson turned in his second lowest output of the season in the loss Sunday. Despite the performance Sunday, Wilson remains the top fantasy option heading into a Week 7 matchup with Miami.

news.body: Garrett Wilson caught seven of his 11 targets for 104 yards and one touchdown in a 17-12 win over the Browns in Week 5.
news.head: Garrett Wilson finds the end zone in Week 5
news.impact: Wilson easily paced the Jets in receiving, hauling in 104 of the team's 182 passing yards in the close win. He found the end zone on a 32-yard strike from Geno Smith in the first quarter. Wilson has now caught 31 passes for 374 yards and three touchdowns across five games. He will be on the WR1/WR2 borderline in Week 6 against the Patriots.

news.body: Garrett Wilson caught three of his four targets for 27 yards in a 23-12 loss to the Bears in Week 4.
news.head: Garrett Wilson held to 27 yards in Week 4
