news.impact: Wilson and the Jets struggled to get anything going in the loss to Chicago. The Jets were held to just 119 passing yards, with most of the damage coming via a 58-yard touchdown pass to Isaiah Williams. Wilson has caught 24 passes for 270 yards and two touchdowns through four games. He will be a low-end WR1/high-end WR2 in fantasy in a Week 5 home matchup against the Browns.

news.body: George Pickens caught 4-of-6 targets for 57 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: George Pickens finds end zone in win Monday
news.impact: Pickens had a productive outing on Monday night. He was able to rack up 57 yards and a touchdown over the course of the game, which left him with a pretty good fantasy total. He will continue to be a boom-or-bust fantasy option on a week-to-week basis moving forward.

news.body: George Pickens caught six of his 11 targets for 73 yards in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: George Pickens goes for 73 yards in Week 6
news.impact: Pickens was held in check in the first half as he had just a 16-yard catch going into halftime. The veteran wideout ultimately wound up leading the Cowboys in receiving yardage in the loss. Pickens now has 33 catches for 428 yards and one touchdown through six games. He will be a WR2 in fantasy in Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

news.body: George Pickens caught 9 of 13 targets for 130 yards and a touchdown in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Bucs on Thursday.
news.head: George Pickens goes off against Tampa secondary
news.impact: Pickens had himself a night on Thursday, partially spurred on by the loss of CeeDee Lamb for a good portion of the game. Pickens was bound to connect with Dak Prescott on a deep shot at some point, given all the different times they had attempted to do so before. He had a nice touchdown grab with his typical no-separation, "Moss" -ing style. Pickens has been an ok asset for fantasy, but certainly not the WR1 like he was last year.

news.body: George Pickens caught 2-of-3 targets for 75 yards in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans.
news.head: George Pickens totals 75 yards Sunday
news.impact: Pickens had a huge 53-yard reception salvage his day. It was the CeeDee Lamb show on Sunday. Pickens remains a WR2 play heading into Thursday’s game against the Buccaneers.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught three of five targets for 27 yards in the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints on Sunday.
news.head: Germie Bernard snags three passes in win over Saints
news.impact: After two great weeks in a row, Bernard was largely held in check by the Saints defense in this one, limited to three short yardage catches. There will be better days ahead, but one thing to keep note of is that the Steelers will have to start getting him some space downfield rather than the short dink-and-dunk targets he's had recently.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught 11-of-12 targets for 87 yards and a touchdown in the Steelers 26-19 win over the Buccaneers.
news.head: Germie Bernard finds the end zone Sunday
news.impact: Bernard took full advantage of his extended opportunity with both Roman Wilson and Michael Pittman Jr. on injured reserve. He scored the wining touchdown in OT as well that he hauled in from Aaron Rodgers. He'll be on the WR3/flex range heading into next week against the Titans.

news.body: Steelers head coach Mike McCarthy said 'football comes easy' to Germie Bernard.
news.head: Germie Bernard draws praise from HC Mike McCarthy
news.impact: "He's acclimated very well to the offense, can play all three positions, and sticks his nose in there," McCarthy said. "I've been very impressed." Bernard is set to step into a bigger role with Roman Wilson week-to-week.

news.body: Germie Bernard caught six of nine targets for 80 yards in the Steelers' 34-22 win over the Colts.
news.head: Germie Bernard has breakout game against Colts
news.impact: Bernard benefited from the absence of Michael Pittman and Roman Wilson, with the former on IR and the latter sustaining a finger injury after attempting a catch. Bernard had some issues with drops, but he showed potential for what he could do with an expanded workload. Look for him to have a healthy target share yet again against Tampa Bay next week.

news.body: Eagles WR Hollywood Brown is officially inactive for a Week 6 matchup with the Panthers.
news.head: Hollywood Brown officially inactive for Week 6
news.impact: Brown was off the final injury report this week, so he may be a healthy inactive. He will have to wait at least one more game before making his 2026 debut.

news.body: Hollywood Brown is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Panthers.
news.head: Hollywood Brown (ankle) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Brown will be a full-go for Sunday against Carolina.

news.body: Hollywood Brown (ankle) was limited at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Hollywood Brown (ankle) limited Thursday
news.impact: Brown was again limited by an ankle injury at practice on Thursday. He remains off of the fantasy radar moving forward, regardless of whether or not he's healthy.

news.body: Hollywood Brown was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Hollywood Brown (ankle) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Brown is continuing to work his way back from an ankle injury. He remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa caught 1-of-2 targets for just ten yards in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa quiet in win Sunday
news.impact: TeSlaa wasn't able to get much going on Sunday. He was targeted just twice and ended with just one catch for ten yards in this win over the Packers. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa failed to catch either of his two targets in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa held without a catch Sunday
news.impact: TeSlaa had close to 100 yards last week, but he did not follow that up with a good performance in Week 5. He wasn't able to catch a single pass on Sunday, despite the fact that Detroit's offense was unstoppable in this win over the Cardinals. He is hard to trust from a fantasy perspective moving forward, as he is likely considered the fifth option on this offense at best.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa hauled in 4-of-8 targets for 95 yards in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa approaches 100 yards on Sunday night
news.impact: TeSlaa had his biggest game of the season so far Sunday night, and has been showing off his big-play ability over the last two games. Over the past two Sundays, the second-year receiver has brought down seven passes for an average of 23.0 yards per catch. TeSlaa has certainly entered the flex conversation as a boom-or-bust option heading into a Week 5 matchup with the Cardinals.

news.body: Isaac TeSlaa caught 3-of-3 targets for 66 yards in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
news.head: Isaac TeSlaa hauls in three passes in Week 3
news.impact: TeSlaa led the team in receiving yardage despite the limited volume. His three receptions and 66 yards both are season highs for the 24-year-old, and he will look to build on this performance in a road matchup against Carolina.

news.body: Jahan Dotson caught 1-of-3 targets for only six yards in Sunday's 29-20 win over the 49ers.
news.head: Jahan Dotson catches one short pass in Sunday's win
news.impact: Dotson has become a big-play wideout for the Falcons, as he had averaged nearly 28 yards on his seven total grabs over the previous three weeks headed into Sunday's game. He had also found the end zone twice in that stretch. However, as should be expected going forward, Dotson showed in this contest that he is a boom-or-bust fantasy option in the Falcons' passing attack.

news.body: Jahan Dotson hauled in three of his five targets for 87 yards and one touchdown in the Falcons' 31-23 Week 6 loss to the Chicago Bears.
news.head: Jahan Dotson finds end zone in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Dotson has made the most of his opportunities in the Atlanta passing offense of late, finishing with over 50 receiving yards in each of his last three contests. The wideout will look to offer head coach another stable pass-catching option moving forward, with a Week 7 contest against the San Francisco 49ers up next.

news.body: Jahan Dotson caught 2-of-4 targets for 54 yards in Sunday's 30-23 OT loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Jahan Dotson finishes with 54 receiving yards in Week 5
news.impact: Dotson made a couple of big grabs in Sunday's game, but he remained no higher than the fourth option in the Falcons' passing attack. Dotson is averaging 18.6 yards per reception and caught his only touchdown so far this season in Week 4. That TD came off the arm of Michael Penix, who is now dealing with a rib injury.

news.body: Jahan Dotson hauled in 2-of-3 targets for 54 yards and a touchdown in Monday night's 45-24 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Jahan Dotson hauls in touchdown Monday
news.impact: Dotson contributed well in Week 4, logging over 50 yards and getting into the end zone in a blowout win over the Saints. This was a good game for the veteran, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to have consistent value moving forward.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane caught 3-of-5 targets for 25 yards in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane hauls in three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Lane has logged five targets in two straight games since returning from injury. Fantasy managers should expect the rookie to continue to get plenty of opportunities in the Ravens' passing attack.

news.body: Baltimore Ravens rookie wide receiver Ja'Kobi Lane caught four passes for 40 yards in Week 6.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane catches four passes in Week 6
news.impact: Lane has been out since Week 1 and was immediately involved in the offense. His receptions, yards and targets were all season highs. Rashod Bateman exited with a shoulder injury, and Lane could have a bigger role if he remains sidelined

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) has been activated from IR, clearing the way for him to return against Cleveland.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) activated off of IR, will play against Cleveland
news.impact: Lane has been out since fracturing his wrist in Week 1, so it will be interesting to see what his snap counts and route shares look like after the IR stint. The team praised him all offseason and focused on him during his brief playing time in Week 1, so hopefully he will be able to find himself a decent role as the WR2 of the offense.

news.body: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) is officially questionable for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Ja'Kobi Lane (wrist) officially questionable for Sunday
news.impact: The rookie will have a chance to make his return to the field after missing several games while on injured reserve. The team will make a determination about his availability closer to game time, and fantasy managers should temper expectations for him this week, especially with QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) set to be sidelined against Cleveland.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers caught 5-of-10 targets for 83 yards in a 34-31 loss to Houston.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers hauls in five passes in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Meyers lead the team in catches and receiving Sunday, falling just one target behind Parker Washington for the team lead. The veteran turned in his best performance of the season so far and will look to build on that after their bye week in Week 7.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers caught 2-of-3 targets for 37 yards in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers finishes with two grabs in Sunday's win
news.impact: Meyers continues to be a reliable receiver for QB Trevor Lawrence, but he has now finished with three or fewer grabs and no more than 40 yards in four of the first five games of the season. Meyers seems to be the third option in the passing game behind top wideout Parker Washington and TE Brenton Strange. Rookie Josh Cameron is on the ascent too.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers caught three passes for 33 yards in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers catches three passes Sunday
news.impact: The veteran wasn't able to do much of note on Sunday, finishing with just 33 yards in a narrow win over the Bengals. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to be relevant moving forward, however, especially with some tough matchups coming up for Jacksonville's offense over the next two weeks.

news.body: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Jakobi Meyers (thumb) listed as limited Thursday
news.impact: As expected, Meyers remained a limited participant for another practice on Thursday. He should be good to go for Sunday's game, however, assuming he doesn't suffer any setbacks between now and then.

news.body: Jalen Brooks caught one of six targets for 35 yards in the Cardinals' 30-16 loss to the Broncos in Week 7.
news.head: Jalen Brooks Catches One Pass in Week 7
news.impact: The six targets were encouraging, but Brooks converted them into just one reception. His lone catch went for 35 yards, showing some big-play upside, but a 16.7% catch rate isn't going to produce consistent fantasy value. Brooks remains a deep-league option rather than a weekly starter.

news.body: Jalen Brooks caught 2-of-3 targets for 30 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Jalen Brooks solid in win Sunday
news.impact: Brooks was able to contribute on Sunday, catching two passes for 30 yards in the team's win over the Rams. He doesn't currently see enough work to be a relevant fantasy option for the foreseeable future, however.

news.body: The Cardinals signed WR Jalen Brooks to their active roster.
news.head: Jalen Brooks signs with Cardinals active roster
news.impact: Brooks had been on the practice squad for Arizona. He takes the roster spot of Andre Baccellia who was placed on IR.

news.body: The Cardinals elevated WR Jalen Brooks from the practice squad.
news.head: Jalen Brooks elevated to Cardinals' active roster
news.impact: Brooks will add depth to a banged up Cardinals wide receiver room. He remains off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Jalen Coker caught just one of four targets for nine yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to the Buccaneers on Sunday.
news.head: Jalen Coker goes quiet in loss to Tampa
news.impact: Coker was coming in on a hot streak and went ice cold in this game. Everyone has a bad day, and the Carolina offense at large failed to do much at all, so it's not like Coker was the only one on the struggle bus. He will look to have a bounce-back night against the Packers on Thursday.

news.body: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Jalen Coker caught six passes for 97 yards while seeing a season-high 13 targets in Week 6.
news.head: Jalen Coker has game-high 97 yards vs. Eagles
news.impact: Coker has at least nine targets in every game he has finished this season, forming an impressive tandem with second-year star Tetairoa McMillan. He had two touchdowns in Week 1 and has not scored since, but Carolina's passing attack has been impressive, and more will come in the future.

news.body: Jalen Coker (quad) practiced in a full capacity again on Thursday.
news.head: Jalen Coker (quad) practices in full again Thursday
news.impact: As expected, Coker was able to log another full practice session on Thursday. He's expected to be close to full health for Sunday's game against the Eagles, in which case fantasy managers can feel comfortable starting him in that matchup.

news.body: Jalen Coker (quad) practiced in a full capacity on Wednesday.
news.head: Jalen Coker (quad) practices in full Wednesday
news.impact: Coker got healthy over the team's bye week last week and seems to be set to make in his return to the lineup in Week 6. He was able to log a full practice to start the week on Wednesday, so unless he suffers a setback throughout the week, fantasy managers should expect him to play and see a full workload against the Eagles on Sunday.

news.body: Jalen Nailor caught two of his five targets for 14 yards in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Jalen Nailor dismal in Week 7
news.impact: Nailor remains minimally involved in the Las Vegas passing attack, recording less than 30 receiving yards in each of seven contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 8 contest against the New York Jets.

news.body: Jalen Nailor caught 1-of-4 targets for nine yards in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Jalen Nailor quiet in loss Sunday
news.impact: Nailor wasn't able to do much on Sunday. He caught just one pass over the course of the game and was only able to turn that into nine yards, which left him with a terrible fantasy total. Fantasy managers shouldn't have high expectations for him moving forward.

news.body: Jalen Nailor (concussion) returned to practice for the Raiders on Thursday.
news.head: Jalen Nailor (concussion) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: Nailor was able to practice in a limited fashion on Thursday, and his return is a good sign that he is trending in the right direction. If he's out for another game on Sunday, fantasy managers should expect more work for Tre Tucker against the Bills.

news.body: Jalen Nailor (concussion) missed Las Vegas' practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jalen Nailor (concussion) misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Nailor is still going through the NFL's concussion protocols and was left sidelined at practice on Wednesday as a result. He is expected to return to practice at some point this week, but it is unclear when that will be exactly or in what capacity. Tre Tucker will see more work if the veteran is sidelined again in Week 6.

news.body: Jalen Royals was unable to catch either of his two targets in a 20-3 loss to the Seahawks in Week 7.
news.head: Jalen Royals targeted twice in Week 7
news.impact: Royals was held without a catch on a disappointing evening for the entire Kansas City offense. The second-year wideout has just five catches on the season. He will not be a strong fantasy play heading into Week 8 vs. the Broncos.

news.body: Jalen Royals caught his only target for 11 yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 win over the Miami Dolphins in Week 3.
news.head: Jalen Royals sees one target in Week 3
news.impact: Royals remains minimally involved in the Kansas City offense early on, recording less than 15 receiving yards in each of his two contests. The wideout remains best left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 4 contest against the Las Vegas Raiders.

news.body: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid told reporters Jalen Royals received first-team reps in practice on Thursday.
news.head: Jalen Royals receives first-team reps Thursday
news.impact: There is an opening in the Chiefs wide receiver room with Rashee Rice away from the team. "With Rashee not here, it gives Jalen some great reps at the wide receiver position," Reid said. "He looks strong out here. Running well. It's great for him. It's great for him and the quarterbacks to see what he's all about."

news.body: Jalen Royals (knee) fully practiced for the Chiefs on Wednesday.
news.head: Jalen Royals (knee) fully practices Wednesday
news.impact: The rookie saw almost no action despite being active in Week 3, but it doesn't seem like his knee injury is still much of an issue, as he was a full participant in Friday's practice. The team is taking their time and letting him get up to speed, so we will probably see him get more involved as the season goes along.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase caught 5-of-7 targets for 62 yards and a touchdown in a 35-13 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase hits pay dirt in Week 7 win
news.impact: Chase found the end zone on a two-yard reception in the fourth quarter to extend the Bengals' lead. Chase has found the endzone in four out of six games so far this season. The star wide receiver will look to continue his strong play in Week 8 against the Titans.

news.body: Ja'Marr Chase hauled in 6-of-10 targets for 77 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Chase was able to clear the NFL's concussion protocols prior to game time on Sunday and looked great in Cincinnati's win over the Dolphins. He led the team in targets, receptions, and receiving yards, and he was also able to get into the end zone on one occasion. He is expected to continue to be a top-tier fantasy option over the rest of the regular season, after the team has their bye week in Week 6.

news.body: Ja’Marr Chase (concussion) is cleared to play for the Cincinnati Bengals against the Miami Dolphins Sunday.
news.head: Ja’Marr Chase (concussion) to play Sunday
news.impact: Chase was able to clear through concussion protocols ahead of the Week 5 contest, offering quarterback Joe Burrow both of his explosive pass-catching options along with Tee Higgins (groin/neck) against the Dolphins Sunday.

news.body: Bengals head coach Zac Taylor said Ja'Marr Chase remains in concussion protocol.
news.head: Ja'Marr Chase remains in concussion protocol
news.impact: Chase was in uniform during practice on Friday. He will have till Saturday to clear all protocols in time for Sunday.

news.body: Jameson Williams caught 5-of-9 targets for 91 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 20-17 win over the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Jameson Williams scores two touchdowns in win Sunday
news.impact: The Lions gave Williams plenty of opportunities on Sunday, and he was able to capitalize on them. He caught two touchdowns and came close to hitting the 100 receiving yards mark, which left him with a terrific fantasy total. He should continue to be viewed as a high-ceiling fantasy option on a week-to-week basis moving forward, though his floor leaves something to be desired.

news.body: Jameson Williams caught 2-of-4 targets for 47 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 45-21 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Jameson Williams scores twice in win Sunday
news.impact: Williams only caught two passes on Sunday, but he was able to get into the end zone on both of them, which left him with a great fantasy total in this win over the Cardinals. He is expected to continue to be a boom-or-bust fantasy option on a week-to-week basis moving forward.

news.body: Jameson Williams came up with 6-of-8 targets for 102 yards in Sunday's 32-26 loss to the Panthers.
news.head: Jameson Williams clears 100 yards in Week 4 loss
news.impact: After being held under 50 yards and no more than four grabs over the first three weeks of the season, Williams finally got going Sunday night. The big-play blazer had a long gain of 49 yards and averaged 17 yards on his half-dozen receptions. Williams should be viewed as an upside WR3 heading into Week 5.

news.body: Jameson Williams caught 4-of-4 targets for 49 yards in a 31-24 win over the Jets.
news.head: Jameson Williams hauls in four passes in Week 3 win
news.impact: Williams took a back seat in the offense Sunday with Amon-Ra St. Brown and Jahmyr Gibbs dominating the targets against the Jets. Williams will look to become more involved in the offense in a Week 4 matchup with the Panthers.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught nine of his 12 targets for 150 yards and a touchdown in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba hauls in TD in Week 7 win
news.impact: Smith-Njigba's crazy production continues as he has at least 100 receiving yards in all but one of his seven games this season while adding eight touchdowns along the way. The star wideout will be a top-three fantasy option heading into Week 8 vs. the Bears on Monday night.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba caught 12 of 16 targets for 134 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 overtime loss to the Broncos on Thursday.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba continues crazy start to season in loss to Denver
news.impact: JSN had himself a night against the Broncos' defense, though he got off to a quiet start. He has 717 yards through six games, a blistering pace of 2,031 receiving yards. He had almost 1,800 receiving yards last year, and if he can match or exceed that in 2026, it would be truly incredible.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba was upgraded to a full practice on Wednesday and has no injury designation for Thursday night.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba practices in full Wednesday, no injury designation
news.impact: JSN was initially listed as limited due to an ankle injury, but it looks like he will be a full go against Denver. Lock him into starting lineups.

news.body: Jaxon Smith-Njigba was listed as a limited practice participant on Tuesday’s estimated injury report.
news.head: Jaxon Smith-Njigba (ankle) limited on estimated practice report Tuesday
news.impact: Smith-Njigba got the same designation on Monday. He should be good to go for Thursday’s game against the Broncos.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle caught four of seven targets for 48 yards in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle Leads Broncos With Seven Targets
news.impact: Waddle led Denver with seven targets but finished third on the team with 48 receiving yards. The encouraging part is the opportunity, as Courtland Sutton saw five targets and no other Bronco had more than three. Waddle remains a weekly fantasy starter despite the modest production, but is no more than a flex.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle (chest) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle (chest) limited again Thursday
news.impact: Waddle was limited for a second-straight practice on Thursday. He's dealing with a chest issue right now, and it remains to be seen if it will leave him with an injury designation heading into the weekend. Courtland Sutton will see more work in the off-chance that Waddle is unable to play in Week 7.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle (chest) was limited at Denver's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle (chest) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Waddle is now dealing with some kind of a chest injury and was left limited at practice on Wednesday as a result. It doesn't seem to be a serious issue at this point, but fantasy managers should continue to monitor his practice participation throughout the week to see if he'll play in Week 7. He remains a debatable starter in most league formats even if fully healthy, however.

news.body: Jaylen Waddle caught four of seven targets for 24 yards in the Broncos' 17-14 win over the Seahawks on Thursday.
news.head: Jaylen Waddle disappoints in win over Seattle
news.impact: Waddle has been a disappointment this season, no way around it. He's not producing, so you can't start him, but you know the potential he holds, so you can't drop him. It's a tough situation for fantasy managers to be in, so do what is best for your roster. If you can afford to hold and not start Waddle, do so. But if you need help, Waddle could be a cut candidate.

news.body: Jaylin Noel (toe) is still having his toe injury evaluated to find the extend of his injury, per HC DeMeco Ryans.
news.head: Jaylin Noel (toe) toe injury still being evaluated
news.impact: Noel left the Texans game against the Giants early on, and did not return due to turf toe. It’s likely he will miss at least a week, and possibly more, but fantasy managers will have to wait for additional news to come out to be certain.

news.body: Texans coach DeMeco Ryans said Jaylin Noel has a turf toe injury.
news.head: Jaylin Noel dealing with turf toe
news.impact: Noel is likely to miss some time. He is off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Jaylin Noel caught all four of his targets for 107 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 34-31 win over Jacksonville.
news.head: Jaylin Noel finds the end zone in Week 6 win
news.impact: Noel found the end zone on a 13-yard connection from C.J Stroud in the third quarter. Noel has shown a positive rapport with Stroud, but will likely remain behind Nico Collins in the pass catcher pecking order for the duration of the season.

news.body: Jaylin Noel caught 5-of-5 targets for 41 yards and a touchdown in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
news.head: Jaylin Noel hauls in five passes Sunday
news.impact: Noel tied Nico Collins for the team-high in receptions on the day. He has shown some flashes, but his role isn't consistent enough to put him on the fantasy radar.

news.body: Jerry Jeudy caught all four of his targets for 21 yards in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: Jerry Jeudy catches four balls in Week 7 win
news.impact: Jeudy was quiet in the close win as he was held under 30 receiving yards for the fifth time in seven games this season. The veteran wideout will not be a recommended fantasy option heading into Week 8 vs. the Steelers.

news.body: Cleveland Browns wide receiver Jerry Jeudy caught four passes for a team-high 69 yards in a Week 6 win against Baltimore.
news.head: Jerry Jeudy paces Cleveland in yards in Week 6
news.impact: Jeudy had his biggest game of the season so far, catching every target for a season-high in yardage. His name has been thrown around in trade rumors after the Browns' rookie wideouts started strong, but he has value as the team's WR3, even if he is not a reliable fantasy producer.

news.body: The Browns are reportedly seeking a third or fourth-round pick for WR Jerry Jeudy.
news.head: Jerry Jeudy could be traded by Browns
news.impact: Jordan Schultz reported he's not sure they’ll be able to get it. Jeudy will be a player to monitor closer to the trade deadline.

news.body: Jerry Jeudy caught three of his seven targets for 19 yards in a 17-12 loss to the Jets in Week 5.
news.head: Jerry Jeudy catches three passes in Week 5
news.impact: Jeudy tied for the lead with seven targets, but he wasn't able to do much with the opportunities. The veteran wideout has been quiet through the first five games of the season, catching just eight passes for 81 yards. He will not be a recommended fantasy option in Week 6 against Baltimore

news.body: Jordan Addison caught 2-of-3 targets for 20 yards in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
news.head: Jordan Addison quiet Sunday
news.impact: It was a low volume day for the entire Vikings passing attack. Addison remains a volatile WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Jordan Addison (hamstring) was officially a full participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jordan Addison (hamstring) officially a full participant Wednesday
news.impact: Addison seems to be close to full health again after Minnesota's bye week last week. He was a full participant at practice on Wednesday and should be a full go for Week 7, although he doesn't project to be a strong fantasy option for the foreseeable future if Justin Jefferson (ankle) is in the lineup.

news.body: Jordan Addison (hamstring) will take part in Minnesota's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Jordan Addison (hamstring) will practice Wednesday
news.impact: Addison is going to be at practice on Wednesday after missing Week 5's game with a hamstring issue. He has had a bye week in between to heal, so he may be fully healthy for Week 7, but we won't know for sure until later on in the week.

news.body: Jordan Addison (hamstring) is inactive for Week 5 for the Minnesota Vikings against the New Orleans Saints according to Tom Pelissero.
news.head: Jordan Addison (hamstring) inactive for Week 5
news.impact: Addison will not suit up after struggling to progress throughout the week for head coach Kevin O’Connell, while No. 1 wideout Justin Jefferson (ankle) is good to go for the Week 5 contest against the Saints.

news.body: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) will not return to practice this week.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) will not practice this week
news.impact: After being selected with the eighth-overall pick in this year's draft, Tyson has yet to make his NFL debut due to a hamstring injury. The rookie is progressing, but he is still not ready to get back on the practice field. Devaughn Vele and Chris Olave will continue to lead the Saints' WR corps.

news.body: Saints coach Kellen Moore said, “not right now" when asked if Jordyn Tyson could practice this week.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) not ready to practice yet
news.impact: Moore adds that Tyson is “progressing well." He remains week-to-week for now.

news.body: Saints coach Kellen Moore said he doesn’t expect Jordyn Tyson to return to practice this week.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) will not return to practice this week
news.impact: Moore did add that Tyson is progressing well. He remains week-to-week.

news.body: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) is still considered “weeks away” from returning from IR due to his hamstring injury, despite being eligible to return at the conclusion of Week 4. It appears Week 7 is the earliest we could see him return, but the Saints bye is the following week, so Week 9 is sounding more realistic.
news.head: Jordyn Tyson (hamstring) still ‘weeks away’ from return
news.impact: It’s a tough blow for Tyson’s stock and for fantasy managers who have held on to him this long. Tyson has loads of promise and could unlock something for a Saints offense that’s already looking good. However, we will have to wait several more weeks to see him on the field, and in his absence, Juwan Johnson and Devaughn Vele will continue to be viable starts.

news.body: Josh Downs caught 2-of-4 targets for 18 yards in the Colts 16-10 loss against the Vikings.
news.head: Josh Downs sees team-high four targets Sunday
news.impact: Downs led the team in targets, while Keenan Allen led the team with just 31 receiving yards. Downs remains on the border of being a WR3/WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Josh Downs caught four of eight targets for 40 yards in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday. He also ran the ball once for seven yards.
news.head: Josh Downs snags four passes in loss
news.impact: Downs once again had a healthy target share, but didn't have a big day, even with Tyler Warren missing the game. Keenan Allen seemed to be the primary beneficiary of Warren's absence. Downs will need to show fantasy managers he can do more to be worth starting in lineups on a regular basis.

news.body: Josh Downs (hamstring) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Tennessee Titans.
news.head: Josh Downs (hamstring) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Downs will be available to play on Sunday, despite popping up on Indianapolis' injury report earlier in the week with a hamstring issue. Look for him to see a large portion of Indianapolis' passing work against the Titans on Sunday, especially if Tyler Warren (groin) is ruled out.

news.body: Josh Downs (rest/hamstring) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Josh Downs (rest/hamstring) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The young wideout was able to practice on Wednesday, though he's dealing with some kind of a hamstring injury and was limited as a result. It looks like he's trending towards playing in Week 6, but we won't know his official status until later on in the week.

news.body: Justin Jefferson caught 4-of-7 targets for 44 yards in the Vikings 16-10 win over the Colts.
news.head: Justin Jefferson quiet Sunday
news.impact: It was a quiet afternoon for the entire Vikings passing attack. Jefferson will remain a WR1 heading into next week against the Lions.

news.body: Justin Jefferson (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Justin Jefferson (ankle) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The Vikings chose to limit Jefferson's workload at practice on Wednesday, though he is likely close to full health after the team's bye week last week. He should play and continue to be a good fantasy option in Week 7, barring something unforeseen.

news.body: Justin Jefferson hauled in six of his seven targets for a team-leading 79 yards and one touchdown in the Vikings' 23-13 Week 5 win over the New Orleans Saints.
news.head: Justin Jefferson finds end zone in Week 5 win over Saints
news.impact: Jefferson has offered mixed results in the Minnesota passing attack to begin the season, reaching the end zone in two of his four contests. The wideout enters the Week 6 bye as one of many inconsistent offensive options for head coach Kevin O'Connell.

news.body: Justin Jefferson (ankle) is officially active for the Minnesota Vikings against the New Orleans Saints according to Tom Pelissero.
news.head: Justin Jefferson (ankle) active for Week 5
news.impact: Jefferson is good to go after not experiencing any issues in pregame activities for head coach Kevin O’Connell, and is is in line for a sizeable workload with Jordan Addison sidelined against the Saints.

news.body: Kalif Raymond did not catch either of his two targets in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Kalif Raymond puts up a goose egg in Week 7
news.impact: Even with Caleb Williams back under center, Raymond has seen just two targets in each of the last two games. The veteran receiver got off to a strong start over the first three weeks of the season and looked like he was going to be a significant contributor for the Bears' offense. That has not remained the case, however, and Raymond can be cut loose in most fantasy leagues.

news.body: Kalif Raymond caught both of his targets for 18 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Kalif Raymond quiet in Week 6 win
news.impact: Raymond has fallen back to earth after a scorching start to the season, finishing with under 20 receiving yards in each of the last three contests. The wideout remains one of the more streaky pass-catching options in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Kalif Raymond hauled in three of his four targets for six yards while also rushing once for a loss of two yards in the Bears' 31-7 Week 5 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Kalif Raymond bottled up in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Raymond has fallen back to earth after a strong start to the season, finishing with less than 10 receiving yards in each of the last two contests. The speedy wideout will look to get back to offering head coach Ben Johnson another impactful pass-catcher ahead of a Week 6 contest against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Kalif Raymond caught both of his targets for six yards in a 23-12 win over the Jets in Week 4.
news.head: Kalif Raymond held to two catches in Week 4
news.impact: Raymond came back to earth in the win after he had been a big part of the Chicago passing attack over the first three games of the season. The veteran wideout now has 21 catches for 220 yards and one touchdown through four games. He will be on the flex radar in Week 5 vs. the Packers.

news.body: KC Concepcion Jr. caught eight of his 10 targets for 129 yards in a 27-24 win over the Titans in Week 7.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. explodes for eight catches, 129 yards in Week 7
news.impact: The rookie easily turned in his best game as a pro as he dominated the Titans in the close win. Concepcion came into the game with just 186 receiving yards on the year and came close to doubling that total while leading the Browns in all receiving categories against Tennessee. He will be a WR3 heading into Week 8 vs. the Steelers.

news.body: KC Concepcion Jr. (calf/quad) was limited at Cleveland's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. (calf/quad) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The rookie is currently dealing with a pair of injuries and was limited at Wednesday's practice as a result. They could affect his availability or workload for Week 7, but we won't know more until later on in the week.

news.body: Cleveland Browns rookie wide receiver KC Concepcion Jr. caught four passes for 37 yards in the team's Week 6 win against Baltimore.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. catches four passes in Week 6
news.impact: Concepcion caught at least four passes for the fourth time in six weeks to open his career. He has been steadily involved in Cleveland's offense, earning five or more targets in all but one week, though he has only exceeded 50 yards once. A big week could be coming soon for the Browns' dynamic receiver, as the team has prioritized giving him touches.

news.body: KC Concepcion Jr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the Ravens.
news.head: KC Concepcion Jr. (concussion) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Concepcion has been able to clear all protocols. He'll remain a WR4 for fantasy managers in his current role.

news.body: Keenan Allen caught 3-of-3 targets for 31 yards in the Colts 16-10 loss against the Vikings.
news.head: Keenan Allen hauls in three passes Sunday
news.impact: It was a low-volume passing day for the Colts offense as Allen led the team in receiving. He remains a low upside WR3/flex play for fantasy managers.

news.body: Keenan Allen (rest) returned to practice as a full participant on Thursday.
news.head: Keenan Allen (rest) returns to practice Thursday
news.impact: As expected, Allen was back at practice on Thursday after getting the day off on Wednesday. He was a full participant and should be fully good to go for Week 7's matchup against the Minnesota Vikings.

news.body: Keenan Allen (rest) was sidelined at Indianapolis' practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Keenan Allen (rest) sidelined at practice Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran was held out of Wednesday's practice, which was to be expected, since the Colts have made a habit out of giving him at least one day off per week. He should be good to go for Week 7.

news.body: Keenan Allen caught 8 of 11 targets for 82 yards in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Keenan Allen grabs eight passes in loss to Titans
news.impact: Allen led the Colts in targets, receptions, and yards in the upset loss. It's a vintage performance for Allen, but if Tyler Warren, who missed this game, is back for Week 7, it will likely signal a downturn in volume for the veteran. However, even so, he's been usable each of the last three weeks, and that trend will likely continue.

news.body: Kendrick Bourne caught three of six targets for nine yards in the Cardinals' 30-16 loss to the Broncos in Week 7.
news.head: Kendrick Bourne Held to Nine Yards in Week 7
news.impact: Bourne saw six targets but averaged just three yards per reception. Even with Jacoby Brissett attempting 48 passes, Bourne couldn't turn the volume into meaningful production. There isn't enough upside here to trust him in fantasy leagues.

news.body: Kendrick Bourne hauled in 5-of-8 targets for 47 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Kendrick Bourne racks up 47 yards Sunday
news.impact: The veteran wideout was productive enough on Sunday. Bourne was able to rack up 47 yards on his five receptions, though he failed to score a touchdown with that, which led to a subpar fantasy total for him. He should continue to have respectable fantasy value as a streaming option for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Kendrick Bourne hauled in 5-of-8 targets for 70 yards in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Kendrick Bourne leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Bourne was a bright spot for the Cardinals on Sunday. He led the team with 70 total receiving yards over the course of the game, although he wasn't able to get into the end zone at all, so his fantasy total remained mediocre. He will continue to be a highly involved member of this passing game moving forward with Marvin Harrison Jr. now out of town for the Cardinals.

news.body: Kendrick Bourne did not log a single target or touch in Sunday's 36-24 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Kendrick Bourne fails to log catch Sunday
news.impact: The veteran was entirely uninvolved on Sunday. He didn't register even a single target against the Giants, so he logged a big goose egg as far as fantasy scoring is concerned. He is not expected to be fantasy relevant at any point for the remainder of the season.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 4-of-6 targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Keon Coleman leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Coleman stepped up with DJ Moore (shoulder) sidelined for the Bills on Sunday. He led the team with 59 receiving yards against the Raiders, and he was also able to get into the end zone at one point, which left him with a nice fantasy total on the day. He should continue to be started in most league formats if Moore has to miss additional time beyond this game.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught one of his two targets for a seven-yard touchdown in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5's Monday night game.
news.head: Keon Coleman catches TD in Week 5
news.impact: Coleman made his only catch count as he hauled in Josh Allen's lone touchdown pass late in the third quarter. It was still a disappointing game for Coleman, who was expected to see a larger target share with DJ Moore (shoulder) inactive. Coleman will be on the flex radar in fantasy in Week 6 vs. the Raiders if Moore isn't ready to return to the field.

news.body: Keon Coleman (ankle) practiced in a full capacity on Thursday.
news.head: Keon Coleman (ankle) practices in full Thursday
news.impact: Coleman was able to practice in a full capacity on Thursday. His ankle injury seems to be a non-issue, so fantasy managers shouldn't be concerned with his health moving forward. He will be primed for a large workload again this week if DJ Moore (shoulder) is unable to play against the Rams.

news.body: Keon Coleman caught 6-of-7 targets for 116 yards and a touchdown in the loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Keon Coleman hauls in a touchdown in Week 4
news.impact: Coleman found the end zone for the first time this season on a 34-yard touchdown reception in the fourth quarter. Coleman set a new season high in yardage and targets in the loss Sunday. Fantasy managers could see Coleman become a bigger part of the offense heading into Week 5 after this performance.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught 4-of-6 targets for 34 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 33-30 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Khalil Shakir finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Shakir was a bit disappointing as far as yardage goes on Sunday, but he made up for that by scoring one of Buffalo's touchdowns through the air. Still, he isn't a reliable fantasy option at this point, and fantasy managers should be especially wary about starting him whenever DJ Moore (shoulder) is back in the lineup for Buffalo.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught all three of his targets for 80 yards in a 37-34 overtime win over the Rams in Week 5's Monday night game.
news.head: Khalil Shakir goes for 80 yards in Week 5 win
news.impact: Shakir led the Bills in receiving, doing most of his damage on a 57-yard catch early in overtime. Shakir now has 18 catches for 256 yards and no touchdowns through his team's first five games. He will be a flex option in fantasy heading into Week 6 vs. the Raiders.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught 7-of-8 targets for 82 yards in the Bills loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Khalil Shakir hauls in seven passes in Week 4
news.impact: Shakir led the team in receptions and targets in the loss Sunday. All three marks are new season highs for Shakir, a potential positive sign for fantasy managers that have rostered him in a tough season. Shakir and the Bills will take on the Rams in Week 5.

news.body: Khalil Shakir caught one of his three targets for six yards in the Bills' 24-16 Week 3 win over the Los Angeles Chargers.
news.head: Khalil Shakir quiet in Week 3 win
news.impact: Shakir struggled to make an impact Sunday, finishing with less than three receptions for the first time in three contests. The wideout remains one of many risky pass-catching options in the Buffalo offense to this point, with a Week 4 matchup against the New England Patriots up next.

news.body: Konata Mumpfield caught one of his two targets for 15 yards in the Rams' 35-21 win over the Las Vegas Raiders in Week 7.
news.head: Konata Mumpfield quiet in Week 7
news.impact: Mumpfield has struggled to make an impact in the Los Angeles passing attack, finishing with under 20 receiving yards in seven of eight contests. The wideout cannot be trusted as a reliable pass-catching option in any format ahead of a Week 8 contest against the Los Angeles Chargers.

news.body: Konata Mumpfield (shoulder) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Konata Mumpfield (shoulder) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: It looks like Mumpfield's shoulder injury is nothing serious, as he was able to log a full practice session to start the week on Thursday. He should be a full go for Week 5.

news.body: Konata Mumpfield caught 1-of-3 targets for seven yards in Sunday's 24-20 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Konata Mumpfield quiet in win Sunday
news.impact: Mumpfield wasn't able to get much going on Sunday, finishing with just one catch for seven yards in a win over the Eagles. He isn't expected to play a big role for the Rams moving forward now that Puka Nacua is healthy and back in the lineup.

news.body: Konata Mumpfield hauled in 4-of-8 targets for 93 yards and a touchdown in Sunday night's 30-26 loss to the Denver Broncos.
news.head: Konata Mumpfield finds end zone Sunday
news.impact: Mumpfield saw next to no action in the first two games of the season this year, but he was stellar on Sunday night. He stepped up and logged 93 yards and a touchdown in the absence of Puka Nacua (hip). He isn't expected to be a reliable fantasy asset moving forward, but if he continues to play well, that will add another dimension to QB Matthew Stafford's game moving forward.

news.body: Kyle Williams caught all three of his targets for 91 yards and a touchdown in the Patriots win over the Raiders.
news.head: Kyle Williams finds the end zone in Week 5 win
news.impact: Williams hauls in a 34-yard pass from Drake Maye early in the third quarter for his first touchdown of the season. This was Williams first contest of the season in which he logged more than one reception. Williams and the Patriots will take on the Jets in Week 6.

news.body: Kyle Williams caught 1-of-3 targets for 34 yards in Sunday's 35-6 blowout loss to the Jacksonville Jaguars.
news.head: Kyle Williams held to one catch Sunday
news.impact: The young wideout got on the field on Sunday and was able to haul in one 34-yard pass against the Jaguars, but he wasn't able to do anything else in the team's blowout loss. It's nice to see him actually on the field for New England, but he doesn't project to have any fantasy value for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Kyle Williams did not record a single target or touch in Sunday's 38-10 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Kyle Williams silent in Week 18 win
news.impact: The rookie was a complete non-factor on Sunday, failing to record even a single target in the team's blowout win over Miami. He showcased a lot of talent throughout his first NFL season, but it remains to be seen if he will take the next step in in 2026 and play more than a supporting role for the Patriots.

news.body: Kyle Williams caught 3-of-5 targets for 20 yards in the Patriots 42-10 win over the Jets.
news.head: Kyle Williams hauls in three passes in Week 17 win
news.impact: Williams was expected to see a larger role in the offense coming into the week with Mack Hollins and Kayshon Boutte out of action. His five targets and three receptions all mark new season highs for the rookie wide receiver. He will look to build on this performance in Week 18 against Miami.

news.body: Ladd McConkey taken out of Sunday's game early due to a concussion.
news.head: Ladd McConkey (concussion) knocked out of Sunday's game
news.impact: The setbacks just continue for McConkey this season. He worked through a foot injury at practice this week. Now, he'll enter the league's concussion protocol after exiting Sunday's game against the Chiefs in the second quarter. McConkey made just one reception for 17 yards prior to leaving.

news.body: Ladd McConkey (foot) will be good to go for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Ladd McConkey (foot) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: McConkey wasn't able to play much last week due to his foot injury, but he seems to be mostly over it at this point, as he is off of the injury report and good to go heading into the weekend. He will almost certainly be Los Angeles' top target in this game, but it's hard to trust starting him at this point with how bad Los Angeles' offense has looked through the first five games of the season.

news.body: Ladd McConkey (foot) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Ladd McConkey (foot) limited again Thursday
news.impact: McConkey was limited for another practice on Thursday, which comes as no surprise, considering that he is uncertain to play in Week 6 due to his foot issue. Friday's injury report should tell us much more about his official injury status heading into the weekend.

news.body: Ladd McConkey (foot) was officially limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Ladd McConkey (foot) officially limited Wednesday
news.impact: McConkey was unable to see any real action last week due to his foot issue. He was able to practice on Wednesday to start the week this week, but he remained limited due to the same injury. He may play through it in Week 6, but it's hard for fantasy managers to trust starting him at this point in the season, even if his health is improving.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell caught two of five targets for 21 yards in the Colts' 26-20 loss to the Titans on Sunday.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell brings in two passes in loss
news.impact: Treadwell continued his trend of catching fewer than 50% of his targets. He's not a great option for fantasy in any format, failing to produce anything even in a depleted pass-catching room.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell caught two of eight targets for 34 yards in the Colts' 34-22 loss to the Steelers on Sunday.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell sees eight targets in Week 5
news.impact: Treadwell had the second most targets on the team, behind the nine of Tyler Warren and Keenan Allen. However, he failed to convert on most of those attempts, although sometimes he was the closest target on throwaway throws by QB Daniel Jones, so the targets are slightly inflated. Still, he's not going to be doing much for fantasy, so it's best to leave him on waivers.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell caught 5-of-6 targets for 42 yards in the Colts win over the Commanders.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell hauls in five passes in Week 4 win
news.impact: Treadwell saw an increase in playing time with the Colts dealing with injuries to Alec Pierce and Keenan Allen. Fantasy managers should expect this to be an outlier, as Treadwell's playing time will diminish once Allen and Pierce return.

news.body: Laquon Treadwell caught three passes for 61 yards in Sunday night's 33-30 OT loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Laquon Treadwell racks up 61 yards Sunday
news.impact: The veteran stepped up on Sunday after Alec Pierce left the game due to a heel injury. Treadwell played well and racked up 61 yards on the night, though he still wasn't great from a fantasy perspective. He should be more involved moving forward but still shouldn't be rostered in most league formats.

news.body: Luther Burden III caught all four of his targets for 130 yards and a touchdown, adding a seven-yard run in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Luther Burden III shows off big-play skills Thursday night
news.impact: Burden and QB Caleb Williams have certainly been on the same page since the latter returned from injury in Week 6. Over the last two games, Burden has come up with all 12 of his targets for a combined 225 yards. The second-year receiver gained a season-high 130 yards on Thursday night, recording the third 100-yard effort of his career. Burden is solidifying himself in the WR2 range for standard fantasy leagues.

news.body: Luther Burden III hauled in all eight of his targets for 95 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Luther Burden III leads pass-catchers in Week 6 win over Falcons
news.impact: Burden III has made the most of increased involvement in the passing attack of late, finishing with four or more receptions in each of his last four contests. The wideout remains one of many pass-catching options that have flashed impactful ability for head coach Ben Johnson, with a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots up next.

news.body: Luther Burden III hauled in four of his six targets for a team-leading 47 yards while also rushing four times for two yards in the Bears' 31-7 Week 5 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Luther Burden III leads underwhelming passing offense in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Burden III has seen consistent involvement in the Chicago passing attack to begin the season, recording four or more receptions in four of five contests. The wideout remains one of the more stable pass-catching options for head coach Ben Johnson ahead of a Week 6 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Luther Burden III caught four of his six targets for 63 yards and added an 11-yard run in a 23-12 win over the Jets in Week 4.
news.head: Luther Burden III goes for 63 yards in Week 4
news.impact: Burden got off to a fast start, catching three of his four passes in the first quarter, but was held to just one catch the rest of the way. He has been trending up, but fantasy managers are still waiting for a blow-up game from the second-year receiver. He will be a high-end WR3 in fantasy in Week 5 vs. the Packers.

news.body: Philadelphia Eagles rookie wide receiver Makai Lemon caught three passes on six targets for 19 yards in Week 6 against Carolina.
news.head: Makai Lemon inefficient on six targets in Week 6
news.impact: Lemon had a season-high 43 yards in Week 5 but recorded his lowest yardage output since Week 2. With 4.5 yards per target through six games, Lemon has started slowly in his rookie year. With a backup quarterback taking over, the Eagles' offense could continue to struggle.

news.body: Makai Lemon caught 5-of-7 targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 19-17 loss to the Jaguars.
news.head: Makai Lemon finishes with five receptions in Week 5
news.impact: Lemon caught 10 passes over the first four weeks of the season. The first-round rookie set a new career high with five receptions in Sunday's game. With DeVonta Smith (hamstring) sidelined for the second straight game, the Eagles needed more out of their other wide receivers. Lemon helped out Sunday, but he's still yet to have a real breakout performance.

news.body: Makai Lemon caught 3-of-6 targets for 27 yards in Sunday's 24-20 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Makai Lemon underwhelming in loss Sunday
news.impact: DeVonta Smith (hamstring) was sidelined for the Eagles on Sunday, but the rookie still wasn't able to take advantage and ended up with just three catches for 27 yards against the Rams. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect much value out of Lemon for the foreseeable future after his slow start to the season.

news.body: Makai Lemon caught three of his four targets for 29 yards in a 27-7 loss to the Bears in Week 3.
news.head: Makai Lemon catches three passes in Week 3
news.impact: Lemon turned in his best game as a pro on Monday night, finishing third on the team in targets and second in catches. The rookie wideout has now caught seven passes for 38 yards through three games. He remains a bench stash in fantasy heading into Week 4 against the Rams.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught 4-of-5 targets for 83 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
news.head: Malachi Fields totals 83 yards Sunday
news.impact: Fields recorded a career-best in yardage in the first start with the Giants for J.J. McCarthy. He remains off the fantasy radar for now heading into the Giants bye week.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught 2-of-8 targets for 19 yards in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints.
news.head: Malachi Fields sees eight targets Sunday
news.impact: Fields was second among Giants wide receivers in targets. It didn't result in much production. He remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught both of his targets for 20 yards in the Giants' 27-27 tie with the Washington Commanders in Week 5.
news.head: Malachi Fields bottled up in Week 5
news.impact: Fields has made minimal impact in the New York passing attack to begin the season, finishing with less than 35 receiving yards in four of five contests. The pass-catcher remains difficult to trust in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest with the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Malachi Fields caught 2-of-3 targets for 52 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 36-24 win over the Arizona Cardinals.
news.head: Malachi Fields hauls in touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Fields looked pretty good on Sunday, finishing with over 50 yards and a touchdown en route to a nice win over the Cardinals. It looks like his rookie season is not yet a wash even with QB Jaxson Dart out of the lineup, but there still isn't a big expectation of fantasy success from the young wideout at this point in the season.

news.body: Malik Nabers caught 7-of-9 targets for 111 yards in the Giants 27-21 win over the Texans.
news.head: Malik Nabers totals 111 yards Sunday
news.impact: Despite the quarterback change, Nabers production remained just as dominant. He remains a WR1 moving forward.

news.body: Malik Nabers caught 12-of-15 targets for 165 yards in the Giants 34-27 loss against the Saints.
news.head: Malik Nabers totals 165 yards Sunday
news.impact: It was a favorable gamescript for Nabers with the Giants trailing big on the afternoon. He did not find the end zone, but made up for it yardage wise. He remains a WR1 regardless of the Giants quarterback situation.

news.body: Malik Nabers hauled in 11 of his team-leading 20 targets for 121 yards and one touchdown in the Giants' 27-27 Week 5 tie with the Washington Commanders.
news.head: Malik Nabers dynamic in Week 5 tie with Commanders
news.impact: Nabers has caught fire in the New York passing attack of late, finishing with over 100 receiving yards and at least one touchdown in each of his last two games. The wideout offers head coach John Harbuagh one of the few explosive pass-catching options in the New York offense ahead of a Week 6 matchup with the New Orleans Saints.

news.body: Giants coach John Harbaugh said Malik Nabers will be “ready to play” on Sunday.
news.head: Malik Nabers (knee) will play Sunday
news.impact: Nabers is coming off a big performance last week against the Cardinals. He should remain in fantasy lineups this week.

news.body: Malik Washington caught 3-of-3 targets for 27 yards in a 28-25 win over the Jets. He rushed for eight yards on two carries.
news.head: Malik Washington hauls in three passes in Week 7 win
news.impact: Washington's three targets are his lowest of the season, which comes on the heels the return of Caleb Douglas to the lineup. Washington will look to bounce back in Week 8 against New England.

news.body: Malik Washington caught 6-of-8 targets for 43 yards in Sunday's 31-24 loss to the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Malik Washington racks up 43 yards Sunday
news.impact: Washington was technically Miami's leading receiver on Sunday, but he accomplished that with just 43 yards on the day, so his fantasy total wasn't much better than anyone else's. He will continue to have a low ceiling on a week-to-week basis moving forward with how bad Miami's offense is.

news.body: Malik Washington caught five passes for 67 yards in Sunday's 15-10 loss to the Minnesota Vikings.
news.head: Malik Washington leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Washington played pretty well on Sunday, finishing with most of the team's receiving yards in their loss to the Vikings. He's one of their only competent receivers at this point, but he still shouldn't be started in most league formats for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Malik Washington hauled in five of his team-high 10 targets for 56 yards while also rushing twice for five yards in the Dolphins' 24-10 Week 3 loss to the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Malik Washington sees seven touches in Week 3 loss to Chiefs
news.impact: Washington has made the most of steady involvement as part of an underwhelming Miami passing attack, posting over 40 receiving yards in each of the first three games. The wideout remains another risky option in a disappointing Dolphins offense to this point, with a Week 4 contest against a disruptive Minnesota Vikings defense up next.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. caught 1-of-4 targets for six yards and a touchdown in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. catches touchdown Sunday
news.impact: For fantasy managers desperate enough to start Harrison, fortunately his lone catch was in the end zone. He remains in the WR4/WR5 range.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. caught 3-of-4 targets for 34 yards in a 34-31 win over Jacksonville.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. hauls in three passes in Week 6
news.impact: Harrison was making his debut for Houston and was figured to only factor into a handful of plays. Despite that, his three receptions tie a season high and the Texans are clearly high on the 24-year-old. Harrison and the Texans will take on the Giants in Week 7.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. (trade) will be available to play in Week 6, according to HC DeMeco Ryans.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. will play Week 6
news.impact: Houston recently made a trade to acquire Harrison from the Cardinals, and he is already going to be ready to play in time for Sunday's game against the Jaguars. He is going to be on a snap count to some degree, so fantasy managers shouldn't trust starting him in his first game as a Texan this week, however.

news.body: Marvin Harrison Jr. has been traded to the Houston Texans, per a report that came out after the Texans win over the Titans.
news.head: Marvin Harrison Jr. headed to Houston
news.impact: Harrison had worn out his welcome in Arizona, and will now be reunited with his college QB. He will look to rebuild his value with his new team, and hopefully provide a viable No.2 target behind Nico Collins. As for the likes of Jaylin Noel, Xavier Hutchinson, Tank Dell, and the injured Jayden Higgins, this will certainly cap their ceilings.

news.body: Marvin Mims Jr. caught both of his targets for 53 yards in the Broncos' 30-16 win over the Cardinals in Week 7.
news.head: Marvin Mims Jr. Records 53 Receiving Yards in Week 7
news.impact: Mims made the most of his two targets, with 47 of his 53 yards coming on one reception. The big-play ability remains obvious, but two targets aren't enough to give him a reliable fantasy floor. Mims remains a boom-or-bust option in the deepest of leagues.

news.body: Marvin Mims Jr. is off the injury report for Sunday's game against the 49ers.
news.head: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) off injury report Sunday
news.impact: Mims remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Marvin Mims Jr. is practicing in full for Week 4 against the 49ers.
news.head: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) practicing in full for Week 4
news.impact: Mims had not practiced since going down with a foot injury in Week 1. He'll be good to return this week.

news.body: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) is inactive for Week 3 for the Denver Broncos against the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Marvin Mims Jr. (foot) inactive for Week 3
news.impact: Mims Jr. will not suit up after entering the weekend carrying a questionable designation for head coach Sean Payton, leaving Jaylen Waddle, Courtland Sutton, and Troy Franklin as the primary pass-catching options against the Rams Sunday night.

news.body: Matthew Golden caught 6-of-12 targets for 39 yards in Sunday's 20-17 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Matthew Golden underwhelming in loss Sunday
news.impact: Golden was the most-targeted receiver for Green Bay on Sunday. He wasn't able to make the most out of those opportunities, however, catching just half of his targets and turning that into 39 scoreless yards against Detroit. This was a bit of a down game for him, but he should bounce back in the near future, especially if he continues to be targeted at this rate.

news.body: Matthew Golden (shoulder) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Matthew Golden (shoulder) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: As expected, Golden is officially off of Green Bay's injury report and good to go for Week 7. He will play against the Lions and should be started in nearly all league formats at this point in the season.

news.body: Packers head coach Matt LaFleur said there's no concern for the status of Matthew Golden.
news.head: Matthew Golden (shoulder) will be good to go Sunday
news.impact: Golden is on the injury report with a shoulder injury. He'll be good to go for Sunday's game against the Lions.

news.body: Matthew Golden (shoulder) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Matthew Golden (shoulder) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: A shoulder issue left Golden limited at Green Bay's practice on Wednesday. It's not thought to be a serious issue at this point, so fantasy managers should tentatively plan on him playing as usual in Week 7, unless we hear a report to the contrary sometime in the next couple of days.

news.body: The Steelers placed WR Michael Pittman on injured reserve.
news.head: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) placed on IR
news.impact: Pittman will miss at least the next four weeks. Roman Wilson and Germie Bernard should both step into bigger roles in the Steelers wide receiver room.

news.body: Steelers coach Mike McCarthy said Michael Pittman re-aggravated his foot injury and will miss multiple weeks.
news.head: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) expected to miss multiple weeks
news.impact: It appears Pittman could be placed on injured reserve. He was seen on a scooter on Wednesday. Roman Wilson will continue to see more opportunity as the Steelers WR2, while Germie Bernard will see more opportunity behind him.

news.body: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) was officially a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Michael Pittman Jr. (foot) officially limited Wednesday
news.impact: The veteran is now dealing with a foot injury of some kind. He was officially limited because of it on Wednesday, but he was also seen moving around on a scooter in the locker room, which makes it seem like a long-shot that he will play this week. If he's sidelined, fantasy managers should look for Roman Wilson to continue to benefit from his absence for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Michael Pittman Jr. was seen on a scooter in the Steelers locker room.
news.head: Michael Pittman Jr. seen on scooter in Steelers locker room
news.impact: It appears to be a foot injury for Pittman. He has been off the fantasy radar when healthy in his current role in the Steelers offense.

news.body: Michael Wilson caught four of eight targets for 55 yards, while rushing twice for 11 yards in the Cardinals' 30-16 loss to the Broncos in Week 7.
news.head: Michael Wilson Totals 66 Yards in Week 7
news.impact: Wilson finished second on Arizona in targets and receiving yards behind Trey McBride, while also getting two carries. Eight targets are enough to keep Wilson relevant, but McBride remains the clear focal point of Arizona's passing attack. Wilson is best viewed as a matchup-dependent flex option.

news.body: Michael Wilson caught 4-of-7 targets for 32 yards in Sunday's 18-16 win over the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Michael Wilson held to 32 yards Sunday
news.impact: Wilson had a disappointing performance on Sunday. He saw plenty of opportunities with seven targets on the day, but he failed to capitalize on them and ended with just 32 yards in total. Fantasy managers should expect him to bounce back and perform better than this in the very near future, however.

news.body: Michael Wilson caught 4-of-7 targets for just 30 yards in Sunday's 45-21 loss to the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Michael Wilson underwhelming in loss Sunday
news.impact: Wilson wasn't able to do much on Sunday, totaling just 30 yards on four catches in a loss to the Lions. He should be the team's clear-cut WR1 moving forward moving forward with Marvin Harrison Jr. now out of town, but he's still subject to having some stinker performances on a week-to-week basis.

news.body: Michael Wilson brought in 7-of-13 targets for 95 yards in Sunday's 36-24 loss to the New York Giants.
news.head: Michael Wilson leads team in receiving Sunday
news.impact: The young wideout was one of the bright spots for the Cardinals on Sunday. He led the team with 95 yards over the course of the afternoon, and he continues to build on the success that he has already found in the first quarter or so of the season. He should continue to be a worthy starter in most fantasy league formats for the foreseeable future.

news.body: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan told reporters he expects Mike Evans to be good to go following the 49ers Week 8 bye week.
news.head: Mike Evans (Achilles) expected to return after bye week
news.impact: Evans sat out the 49ers loss before the bye against the Falcons on Sunday. He'll hope to return after missing just one game.

news.body: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) ruled out for Sunday
news.impact: Evans is not going to be available to play on Sunday. He aggravated his Achilles injury last week, and with the team's bye week coming up in Week 8, they deemed it best to let him sit out this week to recover. Christian Kirk (calf) and Brandin Cooks will both see more work while he's out.

news.body: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) did not take part in San Francisco's practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Mike Evans (ribs/Achilles) doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: As expected, Evans was sidelined at practice on Wednesday. He's still dealing with a lingering groin injury and also aggravated an Achilles issue last week. It looks likely that he will be sidelined this week, especially with San Francisco's bye week right around the corner in Week 8.

news.body: 49ers head coach Kyle Shanahan said Mike Evans is dealing with Achilles soreness.
news.head: Mike Evans dealing with Achilles soreness
news.impact: There is no rupture, which is a positive sign after Evans left Monday's game late in the first half. He'll continue to be further evaluated later in the week.

news.body: Nico Collins caught 2-of-5 targets for six yards in the Texans 27-21 loss against the Giants.
news.head: Nico Collins shut down Sunday
news.impact: Collins was completely held in check. He'll look to bounce back off the bye week.

news.body: Nico Collins caught 3-of-5 targets for 74 yards in the Texans' 34-31 win over Jacksonville. Collins also added five rushing yards on one carry.
news.head: Nico Collins hauls in three passes in Week 6 win
news.impact: Collins saw his production drop with C.J. Stroud spreading the ball around to 10 different pass catchers. He will look to bounce back against a weak Giants' secondary in Week 7.

news.body: Nico Collins caught 5-of-7 targets for 56 yards in the Texans 26-3 win over the Titans.
news.head: Nico Collins sees seven targets Sunday
news.impact: It wasn't a huge afternoon for Collins as Houston controlled the entire game. He will remain a WR1 next week against the Jaguars.

news.body: Nico Collins was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Nico Collins (rest) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: It was a day to begin the week for Collins. He remains a locked and loaded WR1 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. caught 5-of-5 targets for 115 yards and a touchdown in the Jets' 28-25 loss to Miami.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. finds the end zone in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Cooper has put together back-to-back 100 yard performances for the Jets. He did the bulk of his work on receptions of 52 and 60-yards. Fantasy managers should view him as a strong option heading into a Week 8 matchup with the Raiders.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. caught 6-of-7 targets for 103 yards and a touchdown in the 26-19 loss to the Patriots.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. finds the end zone in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Cooper led the team in all receiving categories in the loss Sunday. Cooper had been out of action for the last four games with a high-ankle sprain. Cooper will look to continue to build rapport with QB Geno Smith in Week 7 against Miami.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) will return for the Jets on Sunday against the Patriots.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) to return in Week 6
news.impact: Cooper has not played since he was knocked out of the Jets' season opener with a sprained ankle. The first-round rookie has returned to limited practice sessions this week, and it was announced Friday morning that he's ready for in-game action. With Adonai Mitchell (finger) remaining out this week, Cooper should slot right in behind Garrett Wilson at wide receiver for the Jets. However, there is certainly a chance that Cooper is eased back into the mix as far as total snaps go.

news.body: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) logged a limited practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Omar Cooper Jr. (ankle) logs limited practice Thursday
news.impact: The rookie was able to participate in Thursday's practice in a limited fashion. He is drawing close to a return from the ankle injury that left him on injured reserve, but it's still unclear whether or not his return will come in time for Sunday's divisional matchup against the Patriots.

news.body: Parker Washington caught 4-of-11 targets for 64 yards in the Jaguars' 34-31 loss to the Texans.
news.head: Parker Washington held to four receptions in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Washington led the team in targets, but was unable to do much with them. He finished behind Jakobi Meyers in receptions and receiving yards in the loss, and could not find the end zone despite Trevor Lawrence tossing four touchdowns. Washington will look to rest up in the bye week and bounce back in Week 8.

news.body: Parker Washington brought down 6-of-9 targets for 124 yards and a pair of touchdowns in Sunday's 19-17 win over the Eagles.
news.head: Parker Washington rebounds with huge performance in Week 5
news.impact: Washington eclipsed the 100-yard mark for the first time this season on Sunday, doubling his touchdown total for the season in the process. He looked every bit the part of a dynamic WR1 on Sunday. However, the Jaguars have a plethora of talented pass catchers, and QB Trevor Lawrence does tend to spread the ball around. Still, Washington is a potent fantasy option.

news.body: Parker Washington caught 1-of-3 targets for just seven yards in Sunday's 22-17 win over the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Parker Washington held to one catch Sunday
news.impact: Washington had a total disappearing act on Sunday. He was held to just one catch for a measly seven yards against the Bengals after starting out the first three weeks of the season as a red-hot fantasy option. He should bounce back and return to being a quality starter very quickly, but seeing this kind of floor for the veteran was unexpected and not ideal for fantasy managers.

news.body: Parker Washington hauled in 3-of-5 targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 35-6 win over the New England Patriots.
news.head: Parker Washington hauls in touchdown Sunday
