news.impact: Washington was slightly underwhelming in terms of receptions and yardage on Sunday, but he was able to find the end zone against New England, which left him with a nice fantasy total once again. He has been very good to start the season and should continue to be started in nearly all leagues for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Puka Nacua hauled in eight of his team-leading 10 targets for 68 yards and one touchdown in the Rams' 35-21 Week 7 win over the Las Vegas Raiders.
news.head: Puka Nacua finds end zone in Week 7 win over Raiders
news.impact: Nacua has maximized his role as the primary pass-catching option, posting six or more receptions in each of his last four contests. The wideout offers head coach Sean McVay a dynamic option in the Los Angeles passing attack when healthy, with a Week 8 matchup against the Los Angeles Chargers up next.

news.body: Puka Nacua (calf) is officially active for Week 7 for the Los Angeles Rams against the Las Vegas Raiders according to Ian Rapoport.
news.head: Puka Nacua (calf) active for Week 7
news.impact: Nacua will suit up after passing through pregame checks on his injured calf, offering quarterback Matthew Stafford one of the few potential impactful pass-catching options in a banged-up Rams air attack against the Raiders Sunday.

news.body: Puka Nacua (calf) is questionable for the Rams game against the Raiders with a calf injury.
news.head: Puka Nacua (calf) questionable for Sunday
news.impact: While the calf injury was originally reported to be minor, it seems like that might have been a flat out lie. Puka could still be just fine and see a boatload of targets, but the certainty of his availability just took a big hit. Fantasy managers will need to keep a close eye on his status, especially as his game is in the late afternoon window.

news.body: Puka Nacua left practice early on Thursday due to a calf injury.
news.head: Puka Nacua leaves practice early on Thursday due to calf injury
news.impact: The already injury riddled Rams might have another one to deal with, this time their superstar wideout. With Davante Adams already out, and Terrance Ferguson not ready to return, the team is running short of capable pass catchers. If Puka misses time expect Tyler Higbee and Kyren Williams to see additional work.

news.body: Quentin Johnston caught one pass for 57 yards in the Chargers' 22-6 loss to the Chiefs in Week 6.
news.head: Quentin Johnston Makes 57-Yard Catch in Week 6
news.impact: Johnston's lone reception accounted for more than a quarter of Justin Herbert's 204 passing yards. The big play salvaged his fantasy day, but one reception isn't sustainable production. Johnston remains a volatile option until the Chargers can get him more consistent volume on a weekly basis.

news.body: Quentin Johnston (chest) is off of the injury report for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Quentin Johnston (chest) off injury report for Sunday
news.impact: Johnston was dealing with a chest injury at practice throughout the week, but it seems to be nothing more than a minor issue, as he is off of the team's injury report heading into the weekend. He will play on Sunday and should see more work than usual with Tre' Harris (hamstring) set to be sidelined for the Chargers.

news.body: Quentin Johnston (chest) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Quentin Johnston (chest) listed as limited Thursday
news.impact: Johnston's chest injury continues to linger and left him limited for another practice session on Thursday. Fantasy managers shouldn't expect much production out of him this week, even if he's cleared to play heading into the weekend.

news.body: Quentin Johnston (chest) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Quentin Johnston (chest) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Johnston was not able to play last week due to a chest injury that he's dealing with. He was able to practice on Wednesday, however, which is a good sign that he will be back for Week 6. If he's active, he may see more work than usual if Tre' Harris (hamstring) or Ladd McConkey (foot) are ruled out for Sunday's game.

news.body: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) is out for the Chiefs Week 7 game against the Seahawks on Sunday.
news.head: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) out for Week 7
news.impact: Rice will miss a second straight game due to injury, leaving Xavier Worthy, Jalen Royals, and Cyrus Allen to face off against the Seattle Seahawks secondary. Worthy should at least get some short area PPR scam targets, making him a flex option, but the other receivers are not reliable enough to start as of this moment.

news.body: Rashee Rice did not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Rashee Rice (hamstring/knee) officially misses practice Wednesday
news.impact: Rice is on the injury report with hamstring and knee issues. His status will need to be monitored in practice on Thursday and Friday.

news.body: Rashee Rice will not practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Rashee Rice (hamstring) not practicing Wednesday
news.impact: Rice remained sidelined last week after injuring his hamstring before the Chiefs bye week. His status will need to continue to be monitored in practice the rest of the week.

news.body: Rashee Rice has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Chargers.
news.head: Rashee Rice (hamstring) ruled out Sunday
news.impact: Rice was unable to practice all week. It will be Xavier Worthy, Jalen Royals and Cyrus Allen leading the Chiefs wide receiver room.

news.body: Rashid Shaheed (knee) received positive news regarding his knee injury with the early testing showing that it seems to be minor. Shaheed left Monday nights game against Kansas City early on and did not return.
news.head: Rashid Shaheed (knee) knee injury seemingly minor
news.impact: It’s good news for Shaheed that it seems like he will only miss a few weeks at most. However, if he misses time, Cooper Kupp seems next in line for targets, but AJ Barner also stepped up in his absence as well. Tory Horton appeared to take over return duties, and he could see additional snaps as well.

news.body: Rashid Shaheed caught two of his three targets for one yard in a 20-3 win over the Chiefs in Week 7.
news.head: Rashid Shaheed catches two passes, leaves Week 7 with knee injury
news.impact: Shaheed was held in check in the game before leaving with a knee injury in the first half. The veteran wideout was eventually ruled out for the remainder of the contest on Sunday night. The Seahawks have yet to update his status as they eye a Week 8 matchup against the Bears. For now, consider Shaheed questionable for that game.

news.body: Rashid Shaheed was limited in practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Rashid Shaheed (hip) limited in practice Wednesday
news.impact: Shaheed remains on the WR4/WR5 range for fantasy managers.

news.body: Rashid Shaheed caught five of eight targets for 66 yards in the Seahawks' 17-14 loss to Denver on Thursday. He also caught a two-point conversion and fumbled twice, losing one of them.
news.head: Rashid Shaheed snags five passes in loss
news.impact: Shaheed struggled at times in this game with ball security, but also had some nice grabs downfield and in the short area. It's a bit of a mixed bag for the veteran, but hopefully this is a sign of more involvement in the passing game and Shaheed becoming more of a viable WR2 in Seattle. Granted, Sam Darnold threw 51 passes, so the 8 targets only amounted to a 15.6% target share, but we will take what we can get.

news.body: Rashod Bateman caught 2-of-4 targets for 33 yards in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Rashod Bateman hauls in two passes in Week 7
news.impact: Bateman has seen his role decrease over the last two weeks with the return of Ja'Kobi Lane to the lineup. Bateman is a bench stash at best right now for fantasy managers heading into a Week 8 matchup with the Bills.

news.body: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Cincinnati Bengals.
news.head: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Bateman will be good to go for Sunday's game after being limited by a shoulder issue earlier in the week. He isn't expected to be a trustworthy fantasy option in this game, however, though his ceiling will be raised considerably if QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) is cleared to play ahead of game time.

news.body: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) limited at practice Wednesday
news.impact: Bateman is dealing with a shoulder issue right now. The exact severity of it is unknown, but he was able to practice in a limited fashion on Wednesday, so it appears to be more of a short-term issue. Rookie Ja'Kobi Lane will see more work in Week 7 if the veteran is unable to suit up.

news.body: Ravens coach Jesse Minter said there’s optimism that Rashod Bateman will “be fine.”
news.head: Rashod Bateman (shoulder) hopeful to be fine
news.impact: Bateman remains off the fantasy radar when he is healthy.

news.body: Rome Odunze secured 4-of-5 targets for 69 yards in Thursday's 30-24 win over the Patriots.
news.head: Rome Odunze hauls in four passes Thursday night
news.impact: Odunze seems to still be third in the pecking order of Bears pass catchers behind TE Colston Loveland and fellow wideout Luther Burden. Still, Odunze turned in a solid effort Thursday night. Over the last two games with QB Caleb Williams back at the helm of the offense, Odunze has come up with 7-of-9 targets for 108 yards. The third-year pro has 24 receptions with an average of 15.9 yards per catch through seven games.

news.body: Rome Odunze caught three of his four targets for 39 yards in the Bears' 31-23 Week 6 win over the Atlanta Falcons.
news.head: Rome Odunze quiet in Week 6 win over Falcons
news.impact: Odunze has struggled to make a sizeable impact in the Chicago offense of late, recording less than 50 receiving yards in four of the last five contests. The wideout remains difficult to trust for fantasy managers in all formats ahead of a Week 7 matchup against the New England Patriots.

news.body: Rome Odunze hauled in three of his team-leading nine targets for 40 yards with a fumble lost in the Bears' 31-7 Week 5 loss to the Green Bay Packers.
news.head: Rome Odunze sees nine targets in Week 5 loss
news.impact: Odunze has struggled to make a consistent impact in the Chicago passing attack, finishing with less than 60 receiving yards in four of five contests. The wideout remains a risky pass-catching option in all formats ahead of a Week 6 matchup against the Atlanta Falcons.

news.body: Rome Odunze caught six of his seven targets for 94 yards in a 23-12 win over the Jets in Week 4.
news.head: Rome Odunze goes for 94 yards in Week 4
news.impact: Odunze led the Bears in all receiving categories in what was his best game of the season. The veteran receiver has now caught 14 passes for 233 yards and no touchdowns through four games. Odunze will be a low-end WR3 in fantasy in Week 5 vs. the Packers.

news.body: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) is facing an uncertain timetable to return, per HC Mike Vrabel. When asked about Doubs and when he might come back into the lineup, Vrabel was uncertain and non-commital on a timeline, stating “I’m not sure how long that (his IR stint) will be.”
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) facing uncertain timetable to retun
news.impact: It’s a rough situation for Doubs, who was putting up a big game before going out with a shoulder injury. He’s not droppable jet yet, at least not in leagues with an IR slot. However, he seems to be right on the edge of drop territory, so fantasy managers will need to keep an eye out for any updates regarding his potential return. However, it’s not looking very promising as of writing.

news.body: The Patriots placed Romeo Doubs on injured reserve.
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) placed on IR
news.impact: Doubs left Sunday's game early in the third quarter. He will now miss at least the next four games.

news.body: Romeo Doubs caught his lone target for a 42-yard touchdown in the Patriots' 26-19 win over the Jets.
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) finds the end zone in Week 6
news.impact: Doubs suffered the injury on the touchdown catch in which he landed hard diving for the ball. His status will be worth monitoring ahead of a Thursday night matchup with the Bears.

news.body: Patriots WR Romeo Doubs (shoulder) is questionable to return Sunday against the Jets.
news.head: Romeo Doubs (shoulder) questionable to return
news.impact: Doubs appeared to suffer the shoulder injury on his touchdown reception in the first quarter. The Patriots should update his status after halftime.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught four passes for 70 yards in Monday's 38-21 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy racks up 70 yards in win Monday
news.impact: Flournoy wasn't heavily targeted on Monday night, but he was able to make the most out of his four opportunities by turning them into four catches for 70 total yards. He isn't fantasy relevant at this point, but he is currently a strong contributor for the Cowboys in real life and worth keeping an eye on if someone ahead of him on the depth chart suffers an injury.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught seven of his nine targets for 40 yards and a touchdown in a 23-13 loss to the Packers in Week 6.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy finds the end zone in Week 6
news.impact: Flournoy turned in a solid game while operating as the Cowboys' No. 3 receiver. He caught Dak Prescott's lone touchdown on a six-yard pass with 44 seconds left in the contest. Flournoy now has 23 catches for 234 yards and one touchdown through six contests this year. He will be a decent flex in fantasy in Week 7 vs. the Eagles.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught three of four targets for 90 yards in the Cowboys' 24-16 loss to the Bucs on Thursday.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy goes for 90 yards in loss
news.impact: Flournoy stepped in and made some big plays while operating as the Cowboys' WR2/3 on Thursday with CeeDee Lamb in and out of the lineup due to injury. If Lamb or George Pickens were to miss any time, Flournoy would be a primary pickup.

news.body: Ryan Flournoy caught 4-of-5 targets for 37 yards in the Cowboys 34-30 win over the Texans on Sunday.
news.head: Ryan Flournoy hauls in four passes Sunday
news.impact: Flournoy continues to have a limited role in the offense for Dallas. He is a WR4 for fantasy managers.

news.body: Savion Williams (ankle) will play in Sunday's game against the Detroit Lions.
news.head: Savion Williams (ankle) will play Sunday
news.impact: Williams is going to be available to play on Sunday, despite managing an ankle injury earlier in the week. He isn't expected to see a lot of work against the Lions, however, though his workload will increase if Bo Melton (back) is ruled out ahead of game time.

news.body: Savion Williams (ankle) was limited at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Savion Williams (ankle) limited Wednesday
news.impact: Williams was unable to log a full practice on Wednesday, as he's still dealing with a nagging ankle issue. He was able to play through it last week, however, which suggests that he will do the same again this week.

news.body: Savion Williams (ankle) was considered a limited participant at practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Savion Williams (ankle) considered limited Wednesday
news.impact: Williams was able to practice on Wednesday, although he remained limited due to an ankle issue. His status for Week 6 is undetermined at this point, but either way he remains off of the fantasy radar for the time being.

news.body: Savion Williams (ankle) was limited at practice again on Thursday.
news.head: Savion Williams (ankle) limited again Thursday
news.impact: The Packers recently opened Williams' 21-day practice window, and he was able to practice in a limited fashion for a second-straight day on Thursday. He may play in Week 5, but fantasy managers shouldn't expect him to have much of a fantasy impact even if he's cleared to play this week.

news.body: Stefon Diggs reportedly won’t see a larger role due to the injury to Terry McLaurin, per HC Dan Quinn. The absence of the star receiver will be made up for by others, with Antonio Williams being one of those named.
news.head: Stefon Diggs won’t see bigger role due to Terry McLaurin injury
news.impact: This could easily be coach speak as the Commanders certainly need Diggs’ help with McLaurin out. However, the naming of Antonio Williams was a pleasant surprise, as the rookie has flashed when given the opportunity to perform. He’s a fun name to watch as the season moves on.

news.body: Stefon Diggs caught six of his seven targets for 44 yards and a touchdown in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6's Monday night game.
news.head: Stefon Diggs scores TD in Week 6
news.impact: Diggs set a season-high in catches for the Commanders in the close loss to San Francisco. He found the end zone for the fourth time this season on a one-yard pass from Jayden Daniels late in the third quarter. Diggs should remain a key piece of the Washington passing attack, especially after Terry McLaurin had to be carted off the field with a knee injury on Monday night. The Commanders are on bye in Week 7 before they take on the Eagles in Week 8. Diggs can be considered a solid flex option in fantasy going forward.

news.body: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) is officially active for Week 6 for the Washington Commanders according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) active for Week 6

news.body: Stefon Diggs is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the 49ers.
news.head: Stefon Diggs (hamstring) listed questionable Monday
news.impact: Diggs returned to practice on Friday. He'll be a game-time decision on Monday, but he seems to be trending in the right direction.

news.body: Ted Hurst III failed to catch his only target in the Bucs' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Ted Hurst III shut out in win
news.impact: Hurst was put into the WR3 role after Emeka Egbuka was ruled out due to injury, but it amounted to nothing. He's a boom-bust play at best, and in almost every format, too risky to start.

news.body: Ted Hurst III caught 3-of-6 targets for 40 yards in the Buccaneers 26-19 loss against the Steelers.
news.head: Ted Hurst III totals 40 yards Sunday
news.impact: Hurst continues to act as a field stretcher for the Bucs on the outside. He has been helping their offense, but he remains off the fantasy radar in his current role.

news.body: Ted Hurst III caught two of his three targets for 25 yards in a 17-14 loss to the Packers in Week 4.
news.head: Ted Hurst III goes for 25 yards in Week 4
news.impact: Hurst made a 21-yard catch early in the second quarter but would go on to post just one more catch for a four-yard gain in the loss. The rookie wideout has looked explosive in limited chances this season, catching eight passes for 128 yards and a touchdown through four games. He will face the Cowboys in Week 5.

news.body: Ted Hurst III caught 1-of-4 targets for 40 yards receiving and a touchdown in the Buccaneers 23-16 loss against the Vikings on Sunday.
news.head: Ted Hurst III hauls in deep touchdown Sunday
news.impact: Hurst caught a 40-yard deep ball from Baker Mayfield in the first half for a score. It was his lone catch on the day. The status of Mayfield will need to be monitored after he left late in the loss.

news.body: Tee Higgins caught 6-of-7 targets for 148 yards and a touchdown in the Bengals' 35-13 win over the Ravens.
news.head: Tee Higgins accounts for 148 yards in Week 7 win
news.impact: Higgins gave the Bengals the lead in the third quarter on a 13-yard touchdown reception. This was a much needed bounce back performance after struggling in Week 5 against Miami. Higgins will look to build on this performance in Week 8 against the Titans.

news.body: Tee Higgins caught 2-of-4 targets for just 22 yards in Sunday's 31-24 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Tee Higgins disappoints in win Sunday
news.impact: Higgins was dealing with several different injuries at practice throughout the week, but the team cleared him to play for Sunday's game. He didn't end up producing well, finishing with just 22 scoreless yards on two catches in a win over the Dolphins. He should have a good opportunity to get healthy during Cincinnati's bye week this week, however, so fantasy managers should expect him to bounce back after that.

news.body: Tee Higgins (groin/neck) will play for the Cincinnati Bengals against the Miami Dolphins Sunday according to Adam Schefter.
news.head: Tee Higgins (groin/neck) will play Sunday
news.impact: Higgins is good to go after entering the weekend with a questionable designation, joining Ja’Marr Chase (concussion) back in the Cincinnati passing attack against the Dolphins Sunday.

news.body: Tee Higgins is listed as questionable for Sunday’s game against the Dolphins.
news.head: Tee Higgins (groin/neck) listed questionable Sunday
news.impact: Higgins was able to get in some work during practice on Friday. His status will have to be monitored closer to kickoff on Sunday.

news.body: Terry McLaurin (knee) is out for the rest of the 2026 season with a torn patellar tendon. A tough blow for the veteran receiver and for the struggling Commanders.
news.head: Terry McLaurin (knee) done for 2026 with torn patellar tendon
news.impact: McLaurin suffered the injury in the first half of Washington’s Monday Night game against San Fransisco, coming up lame after trying to run a route, and staying down for some time before being carted off. An MRI today confirmed the injury, and McLaurin will now miss the rest of 2026. Antonio Williams and Chig Okonkwo are now priority waiver pickups for those in need, and if you are in need of a name in deep leagues, Treylon Burks actually had a fair performance on Monday, though he is banged up as well, so his status will need to be monitored. Regardless, Williams and Okonkwo figure to see an uptick in work alongside Stefon Diggs.

news.body: Terry McLaurin (knee) was knocked out of Monday night's loss to the 49ers and will have an MRI on Tuesday.
news.head: Terry McLaurin (knee) to have MRI on Tuesday
news.impact: McLaurin's injury looked quite ugly and the expectation is that the Commanders star wideout will miss the rest of the season. He will undergo further testing on Tuesday to determine the full severity of the injury.

news.body: Terry McLaurin was carted off the field after suffering an apparent leg injury, staying on the ground for several minutes before having an air cast placed on his leg. He has since been ruled out for the remainder of the game. Not a surprise given the circumstances.
news.head: Terry McLaurin carted off field during Monday Night Football
news.impact: The injury occurred while McLaurin was trying to run a route late in the first quarter. The whole Washington roster and several of the Niners veterans, including Mike Evans and George Kittle, also came to wish him well. Fantasy managers will need to watch for updates, but expect a lengthy absence. With McLaurin out, Stefon Diggs and Antonio Williams will see an uptick in work, with TE Chig Okonkwo and WR Treylon Burks also filling in some as well.

news.body: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) was officially a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Terry McLaurin (hamstring) officially limited Thursday
news.impact: McLaurin was able to practice on Thursday, though he remained limited due to the nagging hamstring issue that he's still managing. He should still play in Week 6 and could be startable in many leagues, especially if Stefon Diggs (hamstring) is ruled out for the Commanders.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan caught four of six targets for 40 yards in the Panthers' 43-13 loss to Tampa Bay on Sunday.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan catches four passes in loss
news.impact: McMillan was largely held in check all day by the Tampa defense, as was the rest of the Carolina offense. It wasn't a great showing by the young receiver, but it didn't sink your week. He will look to improve on those numbers against the Packers on TNF.

news.body: Carolina Panthers wide receiver Tetairoa McMillan caught six passes for 86 yards in a Week 6 win over the Philadelphia Eagles.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan gains 86 yards in Week 6 win
news.impact: McMillan has 75+ yards and 8+ targets in four of five games to start the season, a reliable floor in what has been a potent Carolina passing offense. He has not caught a touchdown yet with wide receiver Jalen Coker in the lineup, but McMillan's large frame and target rate indicate more could come in the future after scoring seven as a rookie.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan collected 14 receptions on 16 targets for 192 yards and a pair of touchdowns in Sunday's 32-26 win over the Lions.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan shreds Lions secondary Sunday night
news.impact: For those frustrated by McMillan's paltry output in Week 3, the second-year star erupted for career highs in receptions and yards Sunday night. He also recorded the second multi-touchdown game of his career. It's important to note that this performance came with both Jalen Coker (quad) and Xavier Legette (knee) out, but McMillan still displayed his immense upside. He's a solid WR2 for fantasy purposes at present.

news.body: Tetairoa McMillan caught 2-of-5 targets for just 17 yards in Sunday's 21-18 loss to the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Tetairoa McMillan disappears in loss Sunday
news.impact: McMillan got shut down on Sunday. He was only able to catch two passes for just 17 yards against the Browns, despite being the team's clear WR1 after Jalen Coker (quad) left the game. He should bounce back in the near future, but it's possible that his week-to-week floor will be lower than managers hoped coming into the season.

news.body: Tez Johnson caught both of his targets for 33 yards and a score in the Buccaneers' 43-13 win over the Panthers on Sunday.
news.head: Tez Johnson snags touchdown in win
news.impact: Johnson led the team in receiving yards and caught QB Baker Mayfield's only touchdown of the day in a game dominated by the running game. If Emeka Egbuka misses next week's game as well, Johnson is back in flex consideration. If Egbuka plays, it's fine to let Johnson go back to waivers.

news.body: Tez Johnson caught his only target for 64 yards in the Bucs' 24-16 win over the Dallas Cowboys.
news.head: Tez Johnson snags long pass in win
news.impact: Johnson may not have had a big role, but he had a big moment in the second half, getting left wide open on broken coverage and making the longest play of the night aside from Bucky Irving's 72-yard scamper. Johnson doesn't have a big role at the moment with most everyone healthy, so he's not worth rostering.

news.body: Tez Johnson (groin) is participating at Tampa Bay's practice on Tuesday.
news.head: Tez Johnson (groin) participating at practice Tuesday
news.impact: The young wideout was able to participate in Tuesday's practice after missing some time due to a groin injury that he suffered earlier this month. He will play a bigger role for the Buccaneers if Emeka Egbuka (toe) or Jalen McMillan (knee) have to miss any time due to their injuries.

news.body: Buccaneers WR Tez Johnson left Tuesday’s practice early with a groin injury.
news.head: Tez Johnson (groin) leaves practice early Tuesday
news.impact: Bucs coach Todd Bowles told reporters about the injury. The severity of the injury is unclear. There should be an update later in the week.

news.body: Travis Hunter caught 4-of-4 targets for 59 yards and a touchdown in Jacksonville's 34-31 loss to Houston.
news.head: Travis Hunter hits pay dirt in Week 6 loss
news.impact: Hunter had an amazing day on both sides of the ball, also tallying three tackles and an interception on defense. He set new season highs in receptions, yards, and scored his first touchdown of the season. He should how versatile he can be on offense, so it would not be a surprise to see the Jaguars attempt to get him more involved in the offense after the bye week.

news.body: Travis Hunter had one catch for eight yards and one carry for three yards in the Jaguars' 34-10 win over the Browns on Sunday. On defense, he had one solo tackle.
news.head: Travis Hunter quiet in win over Browns
news.impact: No matter if you play in offense only or in IDP leagues, Hunter is not a player you're happy with right now. His production and usage isn't that of a first-round NFL pick, especially at second overall. The Jaguars are content to use him as a gadget player, and until that changes, he needs to be off of fantasy radars unless you are in dynasty formats.

news.body: Travis Hunter was back on the practice field in training camp on Wednesday.
news.head: Travis Hunter (knee) practices Wednesday
news.impact: Hunter is back on the field from last year’s knee injury. He continues to see reps on both sides of the ball in practice.

news.body: The Jaguars are unsure when Travis Hunter will be a full-go in practice.
news.head: Travis Hunter unsure when he will be full-go in practice
news.impact: Hunter tore his LCL late in October 2025 and missed the rest of his rookie season, which he is still working his way back from. He is expected to play on both sides of the ball this season with more of an emphasis on the defensive side of the ball.

news.body: Tre' Harris (hamstring) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Kansas City Chiefs.
news.head: Tre' Harris (hamstring) ruled out for Sunday
news.impact: Harris is not going to be available to play on Sunday. He's dealing with a hamstring injury right now and will have to miss some time while he recovers. Look for Quentin Johnston to be one of the primary beneficiaries of his absence.

news.body: Tre' Harris (hamstring) missed Los Angeles' practice on Thursday.
news.head: Tre' Harris (hamstring) misses practice Thursday
news.impact: Harris wasn't able to practice on Thursday due to a hamstring injury, which left him sidelined on Wednesday as well. It looks like he's trending towards being sidelined in Week 6, which is bad news for the Chargers with Ladd McConkey (foot) also uncertain to play.

news.body: Tre' Harris (hamstring) officially did not take part in Los Angeles' practice on Wednesday.
news.head: Tre' Harris (hamstring) officially doesn't practice Wednesday
news.impact: Harris is considered week-to-week with a hamstring injury right now, so it's no surprise that he was sidelined at practice on Wednesday. Fantasy managers should look for Quentin Johnston (chest) to see a bit more work if the young wideout is sidelined this week.

news.body: Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh said Tre’ Harris is “more of a week-to-week [thing].”
news.head: Tre' Harris (hamstring) considered week-to-week
news.impact: Harris will likely be targeting a return in Week 8 following the Chargers bye.

news.body: Tre Tucker hauled in five of his team-high 12 targets for 103 yards and one touchdown in the Raiders' 35-21 Week 7 loss to the Los Angeles Rams.
news.head: Tre Tucker leads pass-catchers in Week 7 loss to Rams
news.impact: Tucker has been dynamic in the Las Vegas passing attack of late, recording over 90 receiving yards and at least one touchdown in each of the last two contests. The wideout offers head coach Klint Kubiak one of the more impactful options in the Las Vegas passing attack to this point, with a Week 8 matchup against the New York Jets up next.

news.body: Tre Tucker caught 5-of-7 targets for 97 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 33-30 loss to the Buffalo Bills.
news.head: Tre Tucker stellar in loss Sunday
news.impact: Tucker had a stellar performance on Sunday. He led the team with 97 yards over the course of the afternoon and he was also able to get into the end zone on two occasions, which left him with a great fantasy total on the day. Fantasy managers should consider picking him up if he's available on the waiver wire, as the team may very well try to get him more involved on a week-to-week basis after this game.

news.body: Tre Tucker recorded four receptions on five targets for 41 yards in the Raiders loss to the Patriots. He lost six yards on two rushes in the lost.
news.head: Tre Tucker hauls in four passes in Week 5
news.impact: Tucker led the wide receiver group in targets, but fell behind Brock Bowers and Ashton Jeanty in receptions and yardage. Tucker is likely a volatile option in a Week 6 matchup with Buffalo.

news.body: Tre Tucker caught four of his eight targets for 44 yards in a 30-27 loss to the Chiefs in Week 4.
news.head: Tre Tucker goes for 44 yards in Week 4
news.impact: Tucker tied for third on the team with his eight targets in a game where Kirk Cousins attempted 52 passes. Tucker has been a solid fantasy option this season, posting 15 catches for 233 yards and a touchdown through four games. He will be a fantasy flex in Week 5 vs. the Patriots.

news.body: Treylon Burks caught four of his six targets for 66 yards in a 23-17 loss to the 49ers in Week 6.
news.head: Treylon Burks goes for 66 yards in Week 6
news.impact: Burks finished second on the Commanders in receiving yards behind only Chig Okonkwo. The veteran receiver saw an expanded role after Terry McLaurin suffered a knee injury in the first half and was carted off the field. Burks will have some flex appeal in Week 8 after his Week 7 bye, assuming McLaurin can't play.

news.body: Treylon Burks (shoulder) was listed as a limited participant at practice on Thursday.
news.head: Treylon Burks (shoulder) listed as limited Thursday
news.impact: A shoulder injury left Burks limited at practice on Thursday. It doesn't look like it will leave him sidelined for Week 6, however, and he will again be primed for more work than usual if Stefon Diggs (hamstring) misses another game for Washington.

news.body: Treylon Burks caught two of his five targets for 26 yards in the Commanders' 27-27 tie against the New York Giants in Week 5.
news.head: Treylon Burks quiet in Week 5
news.impact: Burks remains one of many non-factors in the Washington passing attack to begin the season, finishing with under 50 receiving yards in each of his four contests. The wideout can be left off rosters in all formats ahead of a Week 6 contest against the San Francisco 49ers.

news.body: Treylon Burks (shoulder) logged a full practice session on Thursday.
news.head: Treylon Burks (shoulder) logs full practice Thursday
news.impact: As expected, Burks was able to log another full practice session on Thursday. His shoulder injury isn't serious and he is expected to play through it this week, and he may see more work than usual against the Giants with Terry McLaurin (hamstring) and Stefon Diggs (hamstring) both at risk of being sidelined for that matchup.

news.body: Tutu Atwell caught 1-of-2 targets for 19 yards in Monday night's 28-6 win over the New York Giants.
news.head: Tutu Atwell held to one catch Monday
news.impact: The veteran wideout wasn't able to capitalize on the absence of Puka Nacua (hip) on Monday night, hauling in just one pass over the course of the night. He remains off of the fantasy radar for the foreseeable future.

news.body: Tutu Atwell will be inactive against the Niners on Thursday.
news.head: Tutu Atwell inactive against Niners
news.impact: Atwell was recently traded to the Rams from Miami, joining his former team. He will need to wait another week to see the field.

news.body: Tutu Atwell has been traded to the Los Angeles Rams for Jarquez Hunter.
news.head: Tutu Atwell traded to the Los Angeles Rams
news.impact: Either the Dolphins got a good enough look at Tutu to feel fine letting him go, or the Rams are bracing for a potential Puka Nacua suspension and wanted to bring in a familiar face. Or both could be true. Either way, it’s not a good look for Atwell that he made himself expendable on a team desperate for receivers. However, it’s about as favorable a spot as he could’ve landed on.

news.body: The Dolphins are signing free-agent wide receiver Tutu Atwell to a one-year deal.
news.head: Tutu Atwell signs with Dolphins
news.impact: Atwell had a very limited role on the Rams offense last season. He will compete for the WR3 role in Miami. He is likely to remain off the fantasy radar.

news.body: Tyreek Hill’s agent Drew Rosenhaus said he remains in talks with multiple NFL teams.
news.head: Tyreek Hill remains in talks with multiple teams
news.impact: Hill continues to rehab his surgically repaired knee. Rosenhaus added that “nothing is imminent at this time.” He remains without a clear timetable to sign and return.

news.body: Tyreek Hill is expected to sign with a team in the coming days, per his agent. He’s been linked to the Chiefs, but other teams are in the mix.
news.head: Tyreek Hill expected to sign in the coming days
news.impact: Hill could give the Chiefs some depth, but it will be interesting to see how much of an impact he could make at this stage of his career while also coming off of a major knee injury. He’s worth stashing, but keep expectations low.

news.body: Tyreek Hill is not expected to sign with a team before the season begins, according to his agent Drew Rosenhaus.
news.head: Tyreek Hill not expected to sign before Week 1
news.impact: Hill has been on the long road to recovery after sustaining a major knee injury in Week 4 last season, and it looks like he will remain a free agent when the 2026 season begins. However, the 32-year-old could receive interest from contenders as the season goes on if he continues to progress in his rehab.

news.body: Tyreek Hill says that he still has “no power” in his left leg that he injured early on in 2025 while playing for the Miami Dolphins. The free agent receiver still has a ways to go before playing football again.
news.head: Tyreek Hill says he still has ‘no power’ in left leg
news.impact: Hill suffered a gruesome knee dislocation and multiple ligament tears in Week 4 of 2025, missing the rest of the season. It’s a big blow to his chances of finding a team and making his way back onto the field in 2026, especially if he is still struggling to find power in his injured leg. More than likely he will miss the majority of 2026, and its possible he will not see the field again until 2027.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught four of his six targets for seven yards in a 27-24 loss to the Browns in Week 7.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson held to seven yards in Week 7
news.impact: Robinson was held to just 1.8 yards per carry by a tough Cleveland secondary. The veteran wideout has topped 50 receiving yards just twice in seven contests this season. Robinson will be a WR4 in fantasy heading into Week 8 against the Bengals.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught three of seven targets for 22 yards in the Titans' 26-20 win over the Colts on Sunday.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson snags three passes in win
news.impact: Robinson and Carnell Tate were the only pass catchers to catch more than one pass from Cam Ward on Sunday, and also the only two to go over 10 yards. Robinson has had some usable performances this year, but they seem to come on an every-other-week basis.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught 6-of-7 targets for 53 yards in the Titans 26-3 loss against the Texans on Sunday.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson leads Titans in receiving Sunday
news.impact: Robinson posted his third game with 50 yards on the season. He remains a WR3/ flex play next week against the Colts.

news.body: Wan'Dale Robinson caught 3-of-5 targets for 19 yards and a touchdown in the Titans loss to the Ravens.
news.head: Wan'Dale Robinson hauls in three passes in Week 4
news.impact: Robinson caught the lone touchdown pass from Cam Ward against the Ravens, giving Robinson a touchdown in back-to-back games. The 25-year-old will look to continue that streak in Week 5 against the Texans.

news.body: Xavier Worthy caught three of his six targets for 11 yards in a 20-3 loss to the Seahawks in Week 7.
news.head: Xavier Worthy catches three passes in Week 7
news.impact: Worthy turned in a disappointing outing in a tough matchup against Seattle. The speedy wideout was held to 11 yards despite operating as the Chiefs' top receiver with Rashee Rice and Tyquan Thornton both injured. Worthy will be a boom/bust flex option in fantasy in Week 8 vs. the Broncos.

news.body: Xavier Worthy caught seven passes for a team-high 73 yards in the Chiefs' 22-6 win over the Chargers in Week 6.
news.head: Xavier Worthy Leads Chiefs With 73 Receiving Yards in Week 6
news.impact: Worthy didn't find the end zone, but seven catches and a team-high 73 yards made him Kansas City's most productive receiver. The volume is the bigger takeaway here, with Rashee Rice out. Worthy remains one of Patrick Mahomes' top options and should stay in fantasy lineups going forward as a flex-- even when Rice returns.

news.body: Xavier Worthy caught four of his seven targets for 70 yards in a 30-27 win over the Raiders in Week 4.
news.head: Xavier Worthy goes for 70 yards in Week 4
news.impact: Worthy got some extra looks with Rashee Rice injuring his hamstring during the game. The veteran did most of his damage on a 41-yard catch from Patrick Mahomes II. With Week 4 being by far his best game of the season, Worthy will look to stay hot in Week 6 against the Chargers after his Week 5 bye.

news.body: Xavier Worthy caught both of his targets for 20 yards in the Chiefs' 24-10 Week 3 win over the Miami Dolphins.
news.head: Xavier Worthy quiet in Week 3 win
news.impact: Worthy was bottled up by a surprising Miami defensive effort Sunday, finishing with less than three receptions for the first time in three contests. The wideout has struggled to offer fantasy managers a reliable pass-catching option to begin the season, with a Week 4 contest against the Las Vegas Raiders up next.

news.body: Zay Flowers caught 8-of-11 targets for 137 yards and a touchdown in a 35-13 loss to the Bengals.
news.head: Zay Flowers excellent in Week 7 loss
news.impact: Flowers opened the scoring on a 48-yard touchdown in the first quarter. Flowers led the team in all receiving categories, and he will look to do the same in Week 8 against the Bills.

news.body: Baltimore Ravens wide receiver Zay Flowers caught six passes for 66 yards on a season-high 11 targets in Week 6 against the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Zay Flowers logs season-high 11 targets in Week 6
news.impact: Flowers' weekly floor has been impressive this season, recording at least 50 yards in every contest this season. It was his second game with double-digit targets in a concentrated passing attack that has been successful this season. When Lamar Jackson returns, Flowers has a higher ceiling, having failed to reach the end zone in the last two weeks.

news.body: Zay Flowers (toe) is good to go for Sunday's game against the Cleveland Browns.
news.head: Zay Flowers (toe) good to go for Sunday
news.impact: Baltimore's star wide receiver will be available to play on Sunday, despite still dealing with a minor toe injury of some kind. Fantasy managers shouldn't hesitate to start him this week, although his ceiling will be considerably lower than usual with QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) set to be sidelined for another week.

news.body: Zay Flowers (toe) was a limited participant at Baltimore's practice on Thursday.
news.head: Zay Flowers (toe) limited at practice Thursday
news.impact: Flowers is a new addition to Baltimore's injury report. He was limited at practice on Thursday after being a full participant on Wednesday, but this may just be a load management move on the part of the team. For now, fantasy managers should expect him to play in Week 6, although his projected output is likely to be lower than usual with QB Lamar Jackson (ankle) trending towards being sidelined again.
